title: 第七章　信号的世界

zh: 秩序不是客体。
en: Order is not an object.

zh: ——弗里德里希·A.·哈耶克，1968年
en: —Friedrich A. Hayek, 1968

zh: 秩序是调适。
en: Order is adjustment.

zh: ——扬·图姆利尔，1980年
en: —Jan Tumlir, 1980

zh: 到1970年，帝国的时代已近尾声。除了非洲的葡萄牙殖民地以及南部非洲大片地区仍受白人少数派统治之外，昔日幅员辽阔的帝国世界已经分割为一个民族国家的世界。非殖民化浪潮改变了国际组织的成员构成。联合国的成员国已从最初的51个增至127个，非洲、亚洲和拉丁美洲国家构成了明显的多数。以七十七国集团（G-77）的形式组织起来的发展中国家，在整个1960年代间，从不足关税与贸易总协定（GATT，关贸总协定）缔约成员的一半，增长到超过三分之二。
en: By 1970 the age of empire was almost over. Beyond the Portuguese colonies in Africa and persistent white minority rule in much of Southern Africa, a world of formerly sprawling empires had segmented into a world of nation-states. The wave of decolonization transformed the membership of international organizations. The number of countries in the United Nations had grown from the original 51 to 127, with African, Asian, and Latin American countries constituting a clear majority. Developing nations, organized as the Group of 77 (G-77), over the course of the 1960s grew from being less than half of the contracting members to the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) to being over two-thirds.

zh: 无论是在联合国的席位，还是在关贸总协定中的发言权，都不等于自动到手的权力。然而民族独立使新的政治战略成为可能。阿拉伯产油国在1973—1974年石油禁运中所展示的“大宗商品权力”，使全球南方国家备受鼓舞，它们团结起来，形成经济学家马赫布卜·乌尔·哈克（Mahbub ul Haq）1976年所称的“穷国工会”。
它们把国家主权当作“一面盾和一把剑”来使用，利用联合国大会这个讲坛，于1974年通过了关于“国际经济新秩序”（New International Economic Order，NIEO）和《各国经济权利和义务宪章》的决议，要求实现再分配正义、殖民赔偿、对自然资源的永久主权、稳定大宗商品价格、增加援助，并加强对跨国公司的管制。
en: Neither a seat in the UN nor a voice in GATT equaled automatic power. Yet national independence made new political strategies possible. Emboldened by the “commodity power” flexed by the Arab oil-producing countries in the oil embargo of 1973–1974, Global South nations came together in what economist Mahbub ul Haq called in 1976 a “trade union of the poor nations.”

They wielded state sovereignty “as a shield and a sword,” using the forum of the UN General Assembly to pass resolutions on a “New International Economic Order” (NIEO) and a “Charter of the Economic Rights and Duties of States” in 1974, demanding redistributive justice, colonial reparations, permanent sovereignty over natural resources, stabilization of commodity prices, increased aid, and greater regulation of transnational corporations.

zh: 新自由主义思想家认为，欧洲经济共同体（EEC）给予前殖民地的“欧非”（Eurafrican）贸易优惠，恰恰证明殖民主义并未干净利落地终结。七十七国集团的代表们也主张，帝国并未随着形式上的主权而消失。“过去的模式中，私人投资跟着国旗走；如今它被视为国旗的前奏，”贾格迪什·巴格瓦蒂（Jagdish Bhagwati）在1977年写道，“露骨的殖民主义已被狡诈的新殖民主义取代。”
加纳总统克瓦米·恩克鲁玛（Kwame Nkrumah）在一部影响深远的早期论著中写道，殖民者放弃直接行政管理，使得连一场空洞的问责表演都不再必要。新殖民主义是“帝国主义的最坏形式”，他写道，“对实行它的人来说，它意味着有权力而无责任；对受其之苦的人来说，它意味着被剥削而无补救。”
所有权（dominium）的统治甚至可能比统治权（imperium）本身更严酷。
en: Neoliberal thinkers saw the European Economic Community’s (EEC) “Eurafrican” trade preferences for postcolonial nations as evidence that colonialism had not ended cleanly. Delegates from the G-77 also argued that empire had not vanished with formal sovereignty. “Private investments, following the flag in past models, are seen now as precursors of the flag,” observed Jagdish Bhagwati in 1977, “with brazen colonialism replaced by devious neocolonialism.”

In an early influential treatise, Ghanaian president Kwame Nkrumah wrote that the abdication of administration annihilated the need for even an empty performance of accountability. Neocolonialism was “the worst form of imperialism.” he wrote, “For those who practice it, it means power without responsibility and for those who suffer from it, it means exploitation without redress.”
The rule of dominium could be even grimmer than that of imperium.

zh: 国际经济新秩序试图借联合国票数的杠杆来缓解那种无力感。1974年的《宣言》主张，“外来的和殖民的支配、外国占领、种族歧视、种族隔离以及新殖民主义的残余”，在独立之后仍在再生产着不平等。鉴于全球北方公然拒绝兑现它自己的自由主义原则——不在农业等关键部门实行真正的自由贸易——那么为应对以往的发展路径遗留下来的不平等，就有必要对自由主义原则本身作进一步的偏离。正如一位印度驻关贸总协定代表所言，“待遇平等只有在平等者之间才合乎公平。”
由于这种平等在实质上并不存在，全球南方国家就必须争取偏离规则的权利，或争取规则的例外。
en: The NIEO sought to ease the sense of impotence through the leverage of UN votes. The 1974 Declaration contended that “vestiges of alien and colonial domination, foreign occupation, racial discrimination, apartheid and neo-colonialism” continued to reproduce inequality after independence. Given the patent refusal of the Global North to live up to its own liberal principles by practicing actual free trade in key sectors such as agriculture, further deviations from the liberal principles themselves were necessary to account for path-dependent inequality. As an Indian delegate to the GATT put it, “equality of treatment is equitable only among equals.”
Because this equality did not exist sub-stantively, Global South nations had to secure the right to bend or secure exceptions from the rules.

zh: 国际经济新秩序的各项诉求必然是对国际法的挑战。正如一位专家在1973年所说，既有的国际法原则限制了“采取国内经济非殖民化措施的可能性，而这些措施正是法律独立所必需的经济补足”。
1972年，塞内加尔法学家凯巴·姆巴耶（Kéba M’baye）提出了一项“发展权”，它于1977年被人权委员会通过，并于1986年被联合国大会通过。
1970年代中期，联合国国际法委员会着手起草条款，以赋予国际经济新秩序的诉求以法律效力。
国际经济新秩序追求新的法律标准，允许偏离自由贸易，并允许把外资财产收归国有。而这些恰恰是新自由主义者最为担心的对所有权（dominium）领域的侵犯。
en: NIEO demands were necessarily challenges to international law. Existing principles of international law, as one expert put it in 1973, restricted “the possibility for the measures of domestic economic decolonization necessary to provide the economic complement to legal independence.”
In 1972 the Senegalese jurist Kéba M’baye proposed a “right to development,” which was adopted by the Commission on Human Rights in 1977 and the UN General Assembly in 1986.
In the mid-1970s the UN International Law Commission set to work on articles to give legal weight to the demands of the NIEO.

The NIEO aimed for new legal standards that would permit deviations from free trade and allow for nationalization of foreign-owned property. These were the very transgressions of dominium that neoliberals most feared.

zh: 全球南方的言辞在实践中得到了印证。就在国际经济新秩序宣告成立之际，境外美资企业被接管的事件达到顶峰。1967—1971年间有七十九家美国企业被征收；1972—1973年间有五十七家被征收。
在几乎每一件案例中，投资者得到的补偿都与被征收的数额相当，但私有财产规范看似被动摇所造成的不确定性，在北方的商界与政界是一种普遍的忧虑。
国际经济新秩序的反对者试图对世界贸易体系的规则加以微调，以回应此类举动给外国投资者造成的可预期性的破坏。毕竟，如果北方凭借自身权力公然践踏规则，而南方又为弥补自身相对弱势而偏离规则，规则又有什么用呢？
en: Global South rhetoric was reflected in practice. Takeovers of U.S.-owned firms overseas peaked as the NIEO was declared. Seventynine U.S. firms were expropriated in 1967–1971; fifty-seven were expropriated in 1972–1973.

Investors received compensation equal to the seizure in almost every case, but the uncertainty produced by the apparent unsettling of norms of private property was a widespread concern in Northern business and government circles.

Opponents of the NIEO sought to fine-tune the rules for the world trading system in response to the disruption of predictability for foreign investors produced by such moves. What use were rules, after all, if the North flaunted them in its power and the South deviated from them to compensate for its relative weakness?

zh: 如前所述，自1930年代起，日内瓦学派的新自由主义者就相信，只要私有财产权——或者按我从哈耶克那里借用并引申的说法，只要“异邦人权”（xenos rights）——在全世界得到保护，只要资本与商品的自由流动能够规训前殖民国家的行为，帝国就可以终结。国际经济新秩序把对主权与自主性的要求从政治领域延伸到财产领域，因而与规范意义上的新自由主义“双重政府”（double government）模式直接对立。正如战后初期联合国的创建那样，非殖民化终结之后民主原则向国际层面的放大，威胁到了新自由主义者所设想的那个双重化的全球资本主义世界。
en: As we have seen, since the 1930s the Geneva School neoliberals believed that empire could end as long as private property rights—or what I adapt Hayek to call xenos rights—were protected worldwide and the free flow of capital and goods disciplined the behavior of postcolonial states. By extending the demand for sovereignty and autonomy from the realm of politics into the realm of property, the NIEO was in direct opposition to the normative neoliberal model of double government. As with the creation of the United Nations in the immediate postwar period, the scaling up of the democracy principle to the international level after the end of decolonization threatened the doubled world of global capitalism envisaged by neoliberals.

zh: 学者们已经描述了新自由主义者在1970年代如何把矛头对准国际经济新秩序，如何捍卫他们所谓的“自由主义国际经济秩序”以抵御其意识形态挑战者。
在会议、论文和社论中，新自由主义思想家提出了被某位论者称为“反对国际经济新秩序的理由”的东西。
戈特弗里德·哈伯勒已离开哈佛的教席，成为美国企业研究所（American Enterprise Institute）的首位驻所学者，他于1977年召集了这样一次会议。他宣称，国际经济新秩序构成的威胁比共产主义或西方保护主义回潮更为严重。
匈牙利出生的保守派发展经济学家、朝圣山学社（Mont Pèlerin Society，MPS）成员彼得·T.·鲍尔（Peter T. Bauer），以及威廉·H.·哈特（W. H. Hutt）的学生巴西尔·亚梅（Basil Yamey），在论战中走得最远，他们声称国际经济新秩序带来的“不是贫困苦难的缓解，而是极权政府的蔓延”。
一位美国经济学家评论说，鲍尔之激烈，使他“仿佛看到撒拉逊人已到龙塞斯瓦列斯山口、金帐汗国已到维斯瓦河畔、苏莱曼大帝就屯兵维也纳城外——国际经济新秩序对西方文明构成的危险在他看来竟如此巨大。”
en: Scholars have described how neoliberals “took aim” at the NIEO in the 1970s, and defended what they called the “liberal international economic order” against its ideological challenger.
In conferences, articles and editorials, neoliberal thinkers presented what one called “the case against the New International Economic Order.”

Gottfried Haberler, who had left his position at Harvard to become the first resident scholar at the American Enterprise Institute, convened one such conference in 1977. He declared the NIEO a graver threat than either communism or the resurgence of Western protectionism.

Hungarian-born conservative development economist and Mont Pèlerin Society (MPS) member Peter T. Bauer and W. H. Hutt’s student Basil Yamey went the farthest in their polemics, claiming that the NIEO would result in not “an alleviation of the miseries of poverty, but the spread of totalitarian government.”

A U.S. economist remarked that Bauer’s vehemence had him “imagining that the Saracens were at the Pass of Roncesvalles, the Golden Horde at the Vistula, and Suleiman the Magnificent just outside Vienna, such was the enormity of the danger to Western civilization posed by the NIEO.”

zh: 国际经济新秩序所激起的新自由主义怒火，与七十七国集团各国占世界贸易的比重、与它们用来贯彻本质上只是象征性的联合国决议的手段，都不成比例。除了石油这一至关重要的商品之外，建立全球大宗商品卡特尔的尝试很快归于失败，殖民赔偿的要求在西方各国首都也如泥牛入海。
要理解这种恼怒，就要认识到国际经济新秩序并非独自在行动。它在受国际经济新秩序动员起来的、有影响力的北方经济学家和社会民主主义者中找到了盟友。1970年代，一批关键人物与七十七国集团协同行动，把自身的凯恩斯主义规划理念放大到世界层面；同时代的一位批评者称他们为“全球改良主义者”（global reformists）。
en: The NIEO roused neoliberal ire disproportionate to the percentage of world trade accounted for by the G-77 countries or the means at their disposal for enforcing essentially symbolic UN resolutions. Beyond the all-important commodity of oil, attempts to build global commodity cartels were rapid failures and demands for colonial reparations fell on deaf ears in Western capitals.

Understanding the irritation means recognizing that the NIEO was not acting alone. They found allies among influential Northern economists and social democrats mobilized by the NIEO. Acting in solidarity with the G-77 in the 1970s, a key cadre of what one contemporary critic called “global reformists” scaled up their own ideas of Keynesian planning to the world level.

zh: 计算机使人类理性获得义肢式的延展，这对上述努力至关重要。第一次借助计算机来窥见世界经济未来的尝试，是罗马俱乐部（Club of Rome）1972年发表的《增长的极限》（
），它预言若全球消费不减少，后果将不堪设想——而它实际上还遭到许多七十七国集团领导人的批评，因为它似乎排除了发展的可能性，也没有区分世界不同地区所承担的不同责任。罗马俱乐部的第二份报告以《人类处于转折点》（
）为题于1974年出版，与七十七国集团的诉求更为兼容，它预言若不增加援助，发达国家与发展中国家之间的差距将持续扩大。
该报告在联合国被明确呈现为“构建国际经济新秩序的一个参照框架”。
全球改良主义者中包括简·丁伯根（Jan Tinbergen），他早年在国际联盟与哈伯勒交过手，并帮助把凯恩斯主义的语言带进1958年的关贸总协定报告。1974年，丁伯根开始为罗马俱乐部从事研究，以支持国际经济新秩序关于“重塑国际秩序”的要求。
en: The prosthetic extension of human reasoning enabled by the computer was essential to the endeavor. The first computer-aided effort at seeing the world economy’s future was the Club of Rome’s

in 1972, which forecast dire consequences if there was not a reduction in global consumption—and was actually criticized by many G-77 leaders for apparently foreclosing the possibilities of development and not differentiating among the differing responsibilities of different world regions. The second Club of Rome report, published as
in 1974, was more compatible with G-77 demands, predicting a growing gap between developed and developing nations without an increase in aid.
It was presented in the UN explicitly as a “frame of reference in the construction of a New International Economic Order.”

The global reformists included Jan Tinbergen, who had sparred with Haberler at the League of Nations and helped bring Keynesian language into the 1958 GATT report. In 1974 Tinbergen began research for the Club of Rome in support of NIEO demands for the “reshaping of the international order.”

zh: 俄国流亡经济学家瓦西里·列昂惕夫（Wassily Leontief）曾在基尔世界经济研究所（Kiel Institute for the World Economy）受训，1973年因世界经济的计算机模型获得诺贝尔经济学纪念奖。次年他呼吁设立一个国家经济规划委员会（National Economics Planning Board），宣称美国经济是“一台庞大而错综复杂的机器”，人们能够成功地对其加以干预。
1976年他把这一方案推向全球，为联合国发表了所谓《列昂惕夫报告》，为国际经济新秩序张目。
全球改良主义者声援七十七国集团，他们主张，凭借计算机、恰当的数据与开明的政策三者结合，世界经济可以被积极地“重塑”，以产生更为公平的结果。
en: The Russian émigré economist Wassily Leontief, trained at the Kiel Institute for the World Economy, won the Nobel Memorial Prize in Economics in 1973 for a computerized model of the world economy. The next year he called for a National Economics Planning Board, declaring that the U.S. economy was “a gigantic, intricate machine” into which one could successfully intervene.
In 1976 he took the plan global, publishing the so-called Leontief Report for the UN in support of the NIEO.

Expressing solidarity with the G-77, the global reformists argued that that the world economy could be actively “reshaped” to yield more equitable outcomes through the combination of computers, the right data, and enlightened policy.

〔编者注〕列昂惕夫1973年的正式授奖理由是创立投入产出法并将其用于重要经济问题。他在该年的获奖演讲中以世界经济为例阐述了这种方法。

zh: 反对国际经济新秩序与全球改良主义者这两种世界规划，是新自由主义者在1970年代经历的一场使其成形的斗争。在他们看来，七十七国集团滥用了国家主权、动摇了世界经济秩序，为此新自由主义者寻求绕开各国政府权威的途径。到1980年代初，这表现为对投资保护方式与第三方仲裁的重新关注，也表现为对世界银行援助与国际货币基金组织（IMF）援助标准的重新思考——后者后来被称为“华盛顿共识”。
同样重要的是货币主义的兴起，其顶点是1979年所谓的“沃尔克冲击”（Volcker Shock）：它大幅抬高了美国利率——从而也加重了全球南方国家的债务偿付——由此开启了第三世界债务危机，并给予“国际经济新秩序运动以致命一击”。
en: Opposing the world projects of both the NIEO and the global reformists was a formative struggle for neoliberals in the 1970s. Given what they saw as the G-77 misuse of state sovereignty to unsettle world economic order, neoliberals sought ways to circumvent the authority of national governments. By the early 1980s this manifested in renewed attention to modes of investment protection and third-party arbitration alongside the rethinking of criteria for World Bank aid and IMF assistance that would become known as the Washington Consensus.

Equally important was the rise of monetarism, culminating in the so-called Volcker Shock in 1979, which dramatically raised U.S. interest rates—and thus debt service payments for Global South nations—initiating the Third World debt crisis and dealing the “death blow to the NIEO movement.”

zh: 学者们已经追踪了华盛顿共识的兴起以及美国货币治理意识形态的变动。然而他们忽略了国际经济新秩序的挑战在日内瓦本身所激起的那场静悄悄的反革命。

在1970年代和1980年代初，关贸总协定中的三位专家——扬·图姆利尔（Jan Tumlir）、弗里德·勒斯勒尔（Frieder Roessler）和恩斯特-乌尔里希·彼得斯曼（Ernst-Ulrich Petersmann）——明确运用哈耶克的思想来重新思考国际经济秩序，并成为日内瓦学派新自由主义的旗手。关键在于“分层秩序”（stratified order）这一观念，即哈耶克所洞察到的一种同构性：从个体人类认知的层面一直到整个社会的层面。关贸总协定中的这些哈耶克主义者发挥了哈耶克关于秩序的洞见，提出了一套多层级规制与多层级宪政的理论，它在国际经济法这一学科中颇具影响，而该学科正是在1970年代凝聚成形、在1990年代迅速扩张的。他们的思想汇入一条重要的智识溪流，最终通向1995年关贸总协定向世界贸易组织（WTO）的蜕变。
en: Scholars have tracked the rise of the Washington Consensus and shifts in ideologies of monetary governance in the United States. Yet they have overlooked the quiet counterrevolution that the NIEO challenge prompted in Geneva itself.

In the 1970s and early 1980s a trio of experts at the GATT, Jan Tumlir, Frieder Roessler, and Ernst-Ulrich Petersmann, explicitly applied the ideas of Hayek to rethink the international economic order and became the standard-bearers of Geneva School neoliberalism. Key was the idea of “stratified order,” an isomorphism that Hayek perceived from the level of individual human cognition up to society as a whole. The Hayekians at the GATT expanded on Hayek’s insight about order to propose a theory of multilevel regulation and multilevel constitutionalism that became influential in the discipline of international economic law, which coalesced in the 1970s and expanded rapidly in the 1990s. Their ideas fed an important intellectual stream that led to the metamorphosis of the GATT into the World Trade Organization (WTO) in 1995.

zh: 1970年代上演了一场世界经济想象方式的鲜明对峙。七十七国集团与全球改良主义者设想的是一个由民族国家构成的世界经济，国与国之间是不平衡、依附与交换条件恶化的关系，其成因是殖民主义的历史；关贸总协定的改革者们则追随哈耶克，把世界经济设想为一个“自我调节、维持稳态的系统”（homeostatic self-equilibrating system）——一个信息处理机制，其中有层层演化而来的法律，帮助引导价格信号去指挥世界上个人的行为。
关键在于秩序问题。针对国际经济新秩序那种以再分配正义为终局的图景，日内瓦学派的新自由主义者把秩序定义为一种不断变动的关系：在必然不可知的未来，面对刺激并作出回应与调适。新自由主义者提出的不只是一场捍卫现状的后卫战；他们提出了一个框架和一种精神气质，用来辩护那个有悖直觉的主张——“秩序即调适”。
en: The 1970s staged a stark confrontation of world economic imaginaries. While the G-77 and the global reformists envisioned a world economy of nation-states in relationships of unevenness, dependency, and deteriorating exchange produced by a history of colonialism, the GATT reformers followed Hayek to propose a vision of the world economy as a “homeostatic self-equilibrating system”—an information-processing mechanism with strata of evolved laws helping to guide price signals to direct the behavior of the world’s individuals.

At stake was the question of order. Against the NIEO vision of an end-state of redistributive justice, Geneva School neoliberals defined order as a perpetually shifting relationship of exposure to stimuli requiring response and adaptation in a necessarily unknowable future. More than simply a rearguard action to defend the status quo, the neoliberals proposed a framework and an ethos to defend the counterintuitive claim that “order is adjustment.”

zh: 在日内瓦学派版本的相互依赖中，像国际经济新秩序这样处在边缘地带的规则破坏者可能威胁整个系统，因而必须加以约束。新自由主义者的药方是：在一个改革后的关贸总协定之中，在各国形式平等的前提下实现国际经济关系的法律化。规则的多层级校准，将取代国际经济新秩序关于实质平等与给贫穷国家优惠待遇的诉求。他们借助哈耶克的认识论，引入了我所说的“控制论式法律主义”（cybernetic legalism）：把个人视为自我调节系统之内的单元，而立法者的首要责任，就是把系统的规则转化为具有约束力的立法。新自由主义者自己的那个新国际经济秩序之梦本身就极具激进性——那是一个由信号构成的世界经济，一个经由价格与法律传递信息的广袤空间。
en: In the Geneva School version of interdependence, rule-breakers at the margins like the NIEO could threaten the system as a whole and thus needed to be reined in. The neoliberals’ remedy was the legalization of international economic relations under conditions of formal equality for states in a reformed GATT. The multilevel calibration of rules would substitute for the NIEO demands of substantive equality and preferential treatment for poorer nations. Drawing on Hayek’s epistemology, they introduced what I call cybernetic legalism, which saw individual humans as units within a self-regulating system for which the lawmaker had the primary responsibility of transforming the system’s rules into binding legislation. Radical in its own right, the neoliberals’ own dream of a new international economic order was a world economy of signals—a vast space of information transmitted in prices and laws.

zh: “规则人”（
）与知识的僭妄
要理解日内瓦学派新自由主义的特殊性，就必须注意对这一学派影响最深的弗里德里希·哈耶克的理论。这些理论常遭误读。哈耶克1970年代的理论，在把法学领域与经济的不可知性连接起来方面起了关键作用。学者们早已指出，控制论、系统论与心理学是哈耶克认识论中沉默的（有时并不那么沉默）伙伴。
正如新自由主义运动的一支在1947年4月朝圣山学社首次会议之后延伸到国际商会（International Chamber of Commerce）那样，另一支则延伸到系统理论家聚会的所在——欧洲阿尔卑巴赫论坛（European Forum Alpbach）；哈耶克出席了1947年8月的会议，这使他与这门新科学的领军人物有了接触。
1960年代，哈耶克在“自组织原理研讨会”（Symposium on the Principles of Self-Organization）以及1968年的又一次阿尔卑巴赫研讨会上，与系统理论家们再度相遇。
en: Understanding the particularity of Geneva School neoliberalism requires attention to the often misunderstood theories of their most important influence, F. A. Hayek. His theories from the 1970s were critical in linking the fields of law with the unknowability of the economy. Scholars have long argued that cybernetics, system theory, and psychology were the silent (and sometimes not-so-silent) partners in Hayek’s epistemology.

Just as one branch of the neoliberal movement extended toward the International Chamber of Commerce after the first meeting of the MPS in April 1947, another extended to the gathering of system theorists at the European Forum Alpbach, which Hayek attended in August 1947, putting him into contact with the leading lights of the new science.
Hayek crossed paths again with the system theorists in the 1960s at a conference on the “Symposium on the Principles of Self-Organization” and at another meeting of the Alpbach Symposium in 1968.

zh: 哈耶克的工作在1970年代与系统论最为接近，当时他在三卷本巨著《法律、立法与自由》（Law, Legislation and Liberty）中把系统论与自己的法理学理论结合起来。1974年他接受诺贝尔经济学纪念奖时阐发了自己的独特立场，那比列昂惕夫因世界经济计算机模型获奖晚一年，比联合国大会宣布国际经济新秩序晚六个月。在一个对可知未来的信心处于历史高点的十年里，哈耶克的演讲发出了不谐之音。他斥责把物理科学的方法用于研究社会和经济这类“复杂系统”的做法，称之为“知识的僭妄”（pretense of knowledge）。他援引《增长的极限》——该书用计算机模拟警告地球资源日渐枯竭——作为冒科学之名提出的不正当论证的一个例子。他强调的恰恰是知识的界限。呼应自1930年代以来他一直使用的隐喻，他把市场称为一个“通信系统”（communication system），其终极信息无法预知。竞争本身就是一个发现尚未得到充分利用的人类知识和地球资源的过程。人们不能指望获得关于未来的具体数据用来规划，只能指望“模式预测”（pattern predictions）。他承认，在宏大设计盛行的时代，这也许看似科学的“次优”用途，但他争辩说，要抵御“人类控制社会的致命冲动”，就必须学会谦卑。
en: Hayek’s work came closest to system theory in the 1970s, when he combined it with his theory of jurisprudence in his three-volume trilogy,

He elaborated on his particular take in 1974 when he accepted the Nobel Memorial Prize in Economics a year after Leontief had won for his computerized model of the world economy and six months after the declaration of the NIEO in the UN General Assembly. Hayek’s talk struck a discordant note in a decade when confidence in a knowable future was at an all-time high. He rejected as the “pretense of knowledge” the application of the methods of the physical sciences to problems of “complex systems” like society and the economy. He cited

which used computer simulation to warn of the earth’s dwindling resources as an example of an illegitimate argument made under the mantle of science. Instead, he emphasized the limits to knowledge. Echoing metaphors he had used since the 1930s, he referred to the market as a “communication system” whose ultimate message could not be foretold. Competition itself was a process of discovering underutilized human knowledge and earthly resources. One could not hope for concrete data about the future to be used for planning, one could only hope for “pattern predictions.” He conceded this might look like a “second best” use for science in the age of grand designs, but argued that a “lesson of humility” was necessary to fend off “man’s fatal striving to control society.”

zh: 与哈耶克1962年在弗赖堡的就职演讲一样，他主张世界经济即“交换秩序”（catallaxy）是“崇高的”（sublime）。它在理性之外运行，但他所称的“理性的滥用”可能导致它的毁灭。为了追逐“社会正义的幻象”而要求某种预设的经济平等观念，就是扼杀竞争的创造能力、扰乱市场的价格信号，并最终成为“一个任何头脑都未设计过、却由千百万人的自由努力生长起来的文明的摧毁者”。
必须抵御国际经济新秩序这类要求所怀有的“全观错觉”（synoptic delusion），捍卫世界经济的至上性——它超越统计、数学乃至感官知觉。
en: As with his inaugural speech at Freiburg in 1962, Hayek contended that the world economy, or “catallaxy,” was sublime. It operated beyond reason, but what he called the abuse of reason could lead to its ruin. To demand a preconceived idea of economic equality in pursuit of “the mirage of social justice” was to foreclose the creative capacity of competition, scramble the price signals of the market, and ultimately become “the destroyer of a civilization which no brain has designed but which has grown from the free efforts of millions of individuals.”
The sanctity of the world economy—above statistics, mathematics, or even sensory perception—must be defended against “the synoptic delusion” of demands like the NIEO.

zh: 哈耶克的语言听上去像是全球改良主义者话语的反面。然而，尽管他批驳了依赖计算机模型的谬误，他的灵感却来自同一个源头，即系统论。从“模式预测”的说法到他对沃伦·韦弗（Warren Weaver）的援引，哈耶克在诺贝尔演讲中借助系统思维展开论证。1979年，他在《法律、立法与自由》第三卷的导论中把这一立场说得十分明白：正是“控制论以及与之相关的信息论与系统论的成长”，在很大程度上促使他修正了自己的范畴。
他解释说，自己在自发秩序之外采用了“自生秩序”（self-generating order）与“自生结构”（self-generating structure）的观念；取代秩序本身，他现在常用“系统”；以“信息”替换了“知识”。确实，正如学者们所注意到的，哈耶克虽然贬低把计算机应用于经济政策，却提供了这样一种图景：世界经济本身就是一个巨大的信息处理器，超出了人类心智制造或理解它的能力。
en: Hayek’s language sounded like the inverse of the discourse of the global reformists. Yet even as he disparaged the fallacy of computer-aided models, he drew inspiration from the same source of system theory. From the language of “pattern predictions” to his citation of Warren Weaver, Hayek did not argue against system thinking in his Nobel speech but with it. He made the case explicit when he wrote in the introduction to the third volume of his
trilogy in 1979 that “it was largely the growth of cybernetics and the related subjects of information and system theory” that led him to modify his own categories.

He explained that he had adopted the idea of “self-generating order” and “self-generating structure” alongside spontaneous order; in place of order itself, he now often used “system”; for “knowledge” he substituted “information.” Indeed, while Hayek disparaged the application of computers to economic policy, he offered, as scholars have observed, a vision of the world economy itself as an enormous information processor beyond the capacity of the human mind to either manufacture or comprehend.
