zh: 控制论起源于第二次世界大战期间关于自我调节系统的军事研究，具体说是高射炮的设计：其所谓的伺服机构（servomechanisms）能够在无人引导下追踪目标。它最常与诺伯特·维纳（Norbert Wiener）联系在一起，维纳在1947年创造了这个术语，并以其广为阅读的著作推动它流行开来。

然而，尽管控制论与维纳所称的“通信与控制”相联，也意味着在封闭系统内实施全面监督的可能，哈耶克的态度却是把控制论看作一门谦逊的科学：舍弃全知，转而在微观层面识别行动与反应的规则，而这些规则只能外推到宏观层面。他甚至拒绝“控制”（control）一词，而代之以一个他在诺贝尔演讲中再度用到的隐喻：“培育，就像农夫或园丁栽培植物，只了解并能控制部分决定性条件。明智的立法者或政治家也大概会设法培育社会进程中的各种力量，而非控制它们。”
把经济政策比作园艺的这一隐喻，是哈耶克的思想与瓦尔特·欧肯（Walter Eucken）及哈耶克在弗赖堡的同事弗朗茨·伯姆（Franz Böhm）之间诸多联系中的一条。
事实上，如我已论证的，哈耶克式的系统思维常常表现为欧肯开创的秩序自由主义“以秩序思考”传统的一个变体。
en: Cybernetics has its origins in the military research of self-regulating systems during the Second World War, specifically the design of anti-aircraft guns with so-called servomechanisms that could follow a target without human guidance. It is most associated with Norbert Wiener, who coined the term in 1947 and helped popularized it with his widely read book.

Yet despite the association of cybernetics with what Wiener called “communication and control,” and the possibility of total oversight within a closed system, Hayek’s approach was to see cybernetics as a humble science, eschewing omniscience to identify rules of action and reaction at the micro level, which one could only extrapolate to the macro. He even rejected the term “control,” suggesting instead, in a metaphor he returned to in his Nobel speech, “cultivation, in the sense in which the farmer or gardener cultivates his plants, where he knows and can control only some of the determining circumstances, and in which the wise legislator or statesman will probably attempt to cultivate rather than to control the forces of the social process.”
The metaphor of economic policy as akin to gardening was one of many links between his own thinking and that of Walter Eucken and Hayek’s Freiburg colleague, Franz Böhm.
Indeed, as I have argued, Hayek’s version of thinking in systems often appeared as a variation on the ordoliberal tradition of “thinking in orders” pioneered by Eucken.

zh: 哈耶克通过考察人在一系列复杂系统中所处的位置；这些系统，用他从苏格兰启蒙思想家亚当·弗格森（Adam Ferguson）那里借来的一句话来说，是“人类行动的结果，而非人类设计的结果”。

哈耶克由此形成了自己的系统论。人类摸索地走向理解，却永远达不到总体理解的近似值。他们所能指望的最好结果，是一套不过度约束或僭越总体秩序的规则——正如他在诺贝尔演讲中所称的“模式预测”。莱昂·瓦尔拉斯（Léon Walras）说价格是在黑暗中摸索着发现的，哈耶克则认为人以类似的方式达致规则：这是一个试错的演化过程，较有效的规则存续下来，其余的则消逝而去。他在1940年代诗意地表述过这一点，把秩序类比为“小径在崎岖荒野中形成的方式”。“起初，每个人都为自己寻找在他看来最好的路径，”他写道，“但这条路径已被走过一次这一事实，很可能使它更易于通行，因而更可能被再次使用；于是逐渐地，越来越清晰界定的小道出现，并被排他性地使用，其他可能的走法则被弃置。人类在这一地域中的移动会合乎一个确定的模式，它虽是许多人深思熟虑的抉择的结果，却不是任何人有意识设计出来的。”
对哈耶克演化式系统思维的一个重要影响，来自他的一位同时代相识路德维希·冯·贝塔朗菲（Ludwig von Bertalanffy），后者1901年生于维也纳，发展出自己的一支系统论，并于1937年首次为之命名。
贝塔朗菲小心地把自己的“一般系统论”与维纳的控制论区分开来，并强调他与哈耶克共享的源头是1920年代维也纳小组（Vienna Circle）的研究。
1950年代，贝塔朗菲与经济学家肯尼斯·博尔丁（Kenneth Boulding）共同创立了一般系统论学会，并就哈耶克的心理学专著《感官秩序》（
Sensory Order）与哈耶克通信。
与其他系统理论家不同，贝塔朗菲并不把计算机视为理解复杂系统的首要工具，他援引哈耶克的这一观点：在复杂系统中，“原则上的解释”往往已是所能企及的全部。
en: Hayek arrived at his own version of system theory by looking at the place of humans in a range of complex systems that are, in a phrase he borrowed from the Scottish Enlightenment thinker Adam Ferguson, “the result of human action but not of human design.”
Humans fumbled toward understanding without ever arriving at even an approximation of total comprehension.

best they could hope for was a set of rules that did not overly constrain or transgress the overall order—“pattern predictions” as he called them in his Nobel speech. Léon Walras said prices are discovered by groping in the dark, and Hayek saw humans as arriving at rules in a similar way, in an evolutionary process of trial and error, with more efficacious rules surviving as others passed away. He put it poetically in the 1940s, analogizing order to “the way in which footpaths are formed in a wild broken country.” “At first everyone will seek for himself what seems to him the best path,” he wrote, “but the fact that such a path has been used once is likely to make it easier to traverse and therefore more likely to be used again; and thus gradually more and more clearly defined tracks arise and come to be used to the exclusion of other possible ways. Human movements through the region come to conform to a definite pattern which, although the result of deliberate decisions of many people, has yet not been consciously designed by anyone.”

An important influence on Hayek’s evolutionary system thinking was a contemporary acquaintance, Ludwig von Bertalanffy, who was born in Vienna in 1901 and developed his own branch of system theory, named first in 1937.
Bertalanffy was careful to distinguish his “general system theory” from that of Wiener’s cybernetics, emphasizing the origins he shared with Hayek in the studies of the Vienna Circle of the 1920s.
In the 1950s Bertalanffy founded a Society for General Systems
ory with the economist Kenneth Boulding and corresponded with Hayek about the latter’s monograph on psychology,

Unlike other system theorists, Bertalanffy was not wed to the computer as the privileged tool of understanding, and he cited Hayek on the point that “explanation in principle” was often all that was possible in complex systems.

zh: 贝塔朗菲理论的精髓是这样一个命题：各门学科——如生物学、经济学和心理学——的研究对象之间存在同构性。在基本层面，共同的原理和规则约束着可见世界与不可见世界的一切系统。
系统是由“处于互动之中”的各部分构成的整体。
哈耶克接受了贝塔朗菲不拘一格地在不同尺度、不同现象之间进行类比的方式。对他而言，同构性这一前提意味着，居于广义理解之核心的是隐喻而非数学。关于心智、市场与宇宙的质性洞见自由交融，成为他所称的突现秩序或自发秩序、复杂系统的种种例示。
en: The essence of Bertalanffy’s theory was the proposition that there is an isomorphism in the objects of study of the various disciplines, such as biology, economics, and psychology. At a basic level, common principles and rules bound all systems of the visible and invisible world.
Systems were wholes composed of parts “in interaction.”

Hayek embraced Bertalanffy’s promiscuous slippage of analogy between scales and phenomena. For him, the premise of isomorphism meant that metaphor rather than mathematics was central to broader understanding. Qualitative insights about the mind, the market, and the cosmos intermingled freely as diverse instantiations of what he called emergent or spontaneous orders or complex systems.

zh: 要进入哈耶克的系统观念，可以想象一次海滨之行。你涉水走进浅滩，也许能看到一群小鱼游来，大致聚成一个不断变形的球体。鱼群并未整编成齐整的队列，却确实凝聚为一个基本形状。当你靠近，球体消散，随后重新聚拢，接着朝另一个方向游去。对哈耶克来说，秩序必须像水中鱼群的游动那样无计划、自发。正如他1979年针对当时的全球规划尝试所说：“要解释大型社会系统的经济面向，我们必须解释水流的走向，水流整体会随环境变化而不断调适。”
对这类运动作理性协调的尝试必然失败，而且它们会削减秩序赖以运作的那种流动性与即兴能力。哈耶克在弗赖堡的继任者埃里希·霍普曼（Erich Hoppmann）扩展了这个隐喻，写到飞雁的“V”字队形。人们无法预测任何一只雁的行为，却能辨识出其总体秩序的规律。因此，“模式预测是可能的”。
雁本身并不知道规则——它们通过习得的和遗传的行为维持着队形。
en: One can approach Hayek’s idea of the system by imagining a visit to the seashore. Wading in the shallow water, you may see a school of minnows approaching, traveling in a rough and shifting orb. The school is not regimented into even lines but it does cohere as a basic shape. As you approach, the orb dissipates and then reassembles before moving in another direction. Order for Hayek must be as unplanned and spontaneous as the movement of a school of fish in water. As he phrased it in 1979, against contemporary attempts at global planning, “to explain the economic aspects of large social systems, we have to account for the course of a flowing stream, constantly adapting itself as a whole to changes in circumstances.”

Attempts to rationally coordinate such motions must fail, and they can diminish the very fluidity and capacity for improvisation that makes the order function. Hayek’s successor in Freiburg, Erich Hoppmann, expanded on the metaphor, writing about the “V” formation of flying geese. One cannot predict the behavior of any individual goose, but one can discern a rule about their overall order. Thus, “pattern prediction is possible.”
The geese themselves do not know the rules—they adhere to the formation through learned and inherited behavior.

zh: 哈耶克“宪法性无知”（constitutional ignorance）观念的根子在1930年代，但二战之后他才真正发展出这一理论。战争结束数月后，哈耶克在都柏林的一次演讲中说，自由主义的起点是理解个体知识的限度：“真正个人主义的根本态度，是对那些过程抱有谦卑——人类正是借这些过程成就了并非任何个人所设计或理解、而且确实高于个体心智的事业。”
在同一年发表的一篇最知名的文章中，他对此加以阐发：我们每人只拥有经由价格中介的少量信息，他称之为“以简略形式存在的……一种符号”的知识。
通过在自由市场中交换商品与资源，我们利用了这一少量信息。全世界一切个体决策的总和——每个决策都由其自身所占有的那一小片世界知识所引导——汇聚成一种资源的协调，若要由单个个体来尝试，这是不可能的。“整体如同一个市场那样行动，”哈耶克写道。
en: The roots of Hayek’s idea of “constitutional ignorance” are in the 1930s but he developed the theory in earnest after the Second World War. A few months after the end of hostilities, in a talk in Dublin, Hayek said that the beginning of liberalism was understanding the limits of individual knowledge: “The fundamental attitude of true individualism is one of humility toward the processes by which mankind has achieved things which have not been designed or understood by any individual and are indeed greater than individual minds.”

Elaborating on this in one of his best-known articles, published the same year, he argued that we each possess only a small amount of information mediated by price, what he called knowledge “in an abbreviated form … a kind of symbol.”

By exchanging goods and resources in the free market, we make use of that small amount of information. The sum total of all individual decisions everywhere—informed by their own small piece of the world’s knowledge—adds up to a coordination of resources that would be impossible if attempted by a single individual. “The whole acts as one market,” Hayek wrote.

zh: 正如哈耶克在1960年代所描述的，知识问题在微观尺度与宏观尺度上都是一种无穷倒退。最小的与最大的可想象秩序都受相似原理的支配。如一项研究所说，在哈耶克那里，“心智与市场都是复杂系统”。
另一项研究指出，哈耶克模糊了“其分析所运行的层次，无论是大脑、个人还是群体”。
哈耶克成年早期的一段经历，是第一次世界大战结束后的那一年，二十岁的他在苏黎世一间实验室里过了一个冬天，帮助一位解剖学家追踪人脑中的神经纤维。
这段经历既为他提供隐喻，也塑造了他对认知的理解。为了说明实际理解运作中的系统有多困难，他援引神经生物学家的发现：“在几分钟的强烈皮层活动中，实际建立的神经元之间连接的数量（也计入在不同联想模式中被多次触动的连接），很可能与太阳系中的原子总数一样多。”
因此，对哈耶克而言，个人不是最小的研究单元，神经元才是。最高层级的研究单元也不是国家、甚至不是世界——而是宇宙。“严格说来，宇宙之内不存在封闭的系统。”
en: As Hayek described it in the 1960s, the knowledge problem was one of infinite regress on both the micro scale and the macro scale. Similar principles governed both the tiniest and largest imaginable orders. As one study puts it, for Hayek, “both the mind and the market are complex systems.”
Another notes that Hayek blurred “the level that his analysis operated on, be it brains or individuals or groups.”

One of Hayek’s earliest adult experiences was a winter spent in a Zurich laboratory as a twenty-year-old in the year after the First World War, helping an anatomist trace nerve fibers in the human brain.

He drew on the experience for both metaphors and his understanding of cognition. To illustrate the difficulty of actually comprehending the system at work, he cited neurobiologists who found that “during a few minutes of intense cortical activity the number of interneuronic connections actually made (counting also those that are actuated more than once in different association patterns) may well be as great as the total number of atoms in the solar system.”

Thus, the individual is not the smallest unit of study for Hayek. It is the neuron. And the highest unit of study is not the national or even the world—it is the cosmos. “There are, strictly speaking, no closed systems within the universe.”

zh: 为了证明统计的不充分与人类动机的不透明，哈耶克在1964年唤出一个令人惊愕的意象：成群结队的计算机在原野上漫游。他问道，假如“计算机是自然物，我们发现了足够多的数量……并且想要预测它们的行为”，那该如何？我们不仅要知道它们的行为，还须知道其程序设定之中“决定其结构的理论”。由于人是比计算机“复杂得多的结构”，我们不能轻率地把个人当作研究单元。
人类心智之复杂，以至于延展为不可计算的无穷；宇宙亦然。无论在神经元的层面，还是在星系的层面，我们都永远无法达成对自身的、令人满意的观察。
en: As part of his attempt to prove the insufficiency of statistics and the opacity of human motivation, in 1964 Hayek conjured up the startling image of herds of computers roving the landscape. What if, he asked, “computers were natural objects which we found in sufficiently large numbers … whose behavior we wanted to predict”? We would need to know not only their behavior but the “theory determining their structure” in their very programming. Because humans are “much more complex structures” than computers, we cannot blithely take the individual as the unit of study.

The human mind is so complex as to shade off into an incalculable infinity, and the universe is too. We are never able to arrive at a satisfying observation of our selves either at the level of the neuron or at the level of the galaxy.

zh: 哈耶克的核心命题之一——理解1970年代以来日内瓦学派新自由主义转型的关键——是：市场建立在先于认知（
）的对价格信号的反应之上。在1963年的一段代表性表述中，他声称：“人大多不知道自己的行动遵循哪些规则；甚至我们所谓的智慧，也主要是一套在他身上运作而他并不知晓的规则系统。”

正是这种对“先于认知”之物、对先于理性之物的推崇，把他与芝加哥学派经济学家的理性选择模型和理性预期模型区分开来，后者对形式化数学建模与预测的可能性抱有深得多的信念。正如他在诺贝尔演讲中所解释的，哈耶克认为这类努力不仅是僭妄的，而且有误导性。人所能指望的最好结果就是模式预测。而这种预测本已内在于我们在世界上行动的方式。1964年，他写到“我们的感官对模式识别的直觉能力”——“我们的所见所闻既是模式，也是单个事件，而不必诉诸理智操作。”
他与霍普曼一样诉诸动物行为学（ethology），即对动物行为的研究，指出“对鱼类和鸟类的实验……表明它们对那些只有某些极为抽象的共同特征的千变万化的形状，以同样的方式作出反应。”
这使他相信，基本的反应所涉及的不是简单，而是一种不自知的抽象，是动物（包括人这种动物）天生具有的一种在不自觉的情况下识别复杂性的能力。“把这类过程称为‘超意识的’而非‘潜意识的’似乎更为妥当，”他争辩道，“因为它们支配着意识过程，自己却不出现在其中。”
en: One of Hayek’s core propositions, key to understanding the transformations of Geneva School neoliberalism since the 1970s, is that the market is built on

responses to price signals. In a representative statement from 1963, he claimed, “Man does not know most of the rules on which he acts; and even what we call his intelligence is largely a system of rules which operate on him but which he does not know.”
This deference to the

or the pre-rational is what separated him from the rational choice and rational expectations models of Chicago School economists, who professed much more faith in the possibility of both formal mathematical modeling and forecasting. As he explained in his Nobel speech, Hayek saw such efforts as not only presumptuous but misleading. The best one could hope for was pattern prediction. Such prediction was already innate to the way we navigate in the world. In 1964 he wrote of “the intuitive capacity of our senses for pattern recognition”—“we see and hear patterns as much as individual events without having to resort to intellectual operations.”

Appealing like Hoppmann to ethology, or the study of animal behavior, he noted that “experiments with fishes and birds … show that they respond in the same manner to a great variety of shapes which have only some very abstract features in common.”

This led him to believe that basic reactions involve, not simplicity, but an unwitting abstraction, an innate ability in animals, including the human animal, to recognize complexity without realizing they are doing so. “It would seem much more appropriate to call such processes not ‘subconscious’ but ‘super-conscious,’ ” he argued, “because they govern the conscious processes without appearing in them.”

zh: 在1968年阿尔卑巴赫控制论会议上，哈耶克在一次随口说出的关键表态中说，“秩序不是客体”，而是“事件的秩序”。
他的世界经济图景就像那群鱼、一组神经元的复合体、一个星系——一个不断调适的整体，人类心智永远不能、也绝不应试图去复制它。辨识系统内部抽象原则的唯一途径，“是借助物理学家所谓的宇宙论，也就是关于它们如何演化的理论。”
“星系或太阳系如何形成的问题，”他写道，“远比力学的问题更像社会科学所必须面对的问题。”
就未来而言，调适的能力必须时刻为意外做好准备。在他1952年那部心理学著作中，他提供了一个富有感染力的类比：叶片“调整到风阻最小的姿态，以免被大风撕碎”。
“我们所谓的理解，”他后来写道，“归根结底只是[人]以一套有助于其存续的行动模式来回应其环境的能力。”
系统之所以存续——秩序之所以生成——靠的是个体通过反射性的反应再生产自身与整体。
en: In a key offhand statement at the Alpbach cybernetics conference in 1968, Hayek said that “order is not an object” but an “order of events.”

His vision of the world economy is like the school of fish, a complex of neurons, a galaxy—an ever-adapting whole that the human mind can never—and must never—seek to replicate. The only way to descry the abstract principles within the system was “by what the physicists would call a cosmology, that is, a theory of their evolution.”
“The problem of how galaxies or solar systems are formed,” he wrote, “is much more like the problems which the social sciences have to face than the problems of mechanics.”

In terms of the future, the capacity to adjust must always prepare for the unexpected. In an evocative analogy from his book on psychology from 1952, he offered the metaphor of the leaf, which “avoids being torn to shreds by a high wind by taking up a position of least resistance.”
“What we call understanding,” he wrote later, “is in the last resort simply [man’s] capacity to respond to his environment with a pattern of actions that helps him to persist.”
The system survives—and order results—through the reflexive efforts of individuals to reproduce both themselves and the totality.

zh: 细加审视便会发现，在哈耶克的理论中，市场行动者的自由意志出人意料地有限。他不止一次回到的一个隐喻是铁屑：“我们把铁屑撒在纸上，纸下的磁铁使铁屑磁化。”它们“会彼此作用并对彼此作出反应，以致排列成一个特征性的图形，我们能预测其总体形状，却不能预测其细节。”
他从这一类比得出的结论是：“支配这类自发秩序之要素行动的规则，不必是这些要素‘知晓’的规则。”
他偏爱的另一个意味深长的隐喻，是在实验室里复原一颗晶体的尝试。我们永远无法直接造出晶体——“把一个个原子放置在形成晶体晶格、或形成构成有机化合物的苯环系统的位置上，”他写道。但“我们能够创造出使它们自行如此排列的条件。”
en: On examination, one finds that in Hayek’s theory the free will of the market actor is surprisingly limited. A metaphor that he returned to more than once is that of iron filings “magnetized by a magnet under the sheet of paper on which we have poured them.” The filings “will so act on and react to all the others that they will arrange themselves in a characteristic figure of which we can predict the general shape but not the detail.”
What he concluded from the analogy was that “the rules which govern the actions of the elements of such spontaneous orders need not be rules which are ‘known’ to these elements.”

Another telling metaphor he favored was that of the attempt to recreate a crystal in a laboratory. We can never produce the crystal directly “by placing the individual atoms in such a position that they will form the lattice of a crystal or the system based on benzol rings which make up an organic compound,” he wrote. But “we can create the conditions in which they will arrange themselves in such a manner.”

zh: 哈耶克的论点是，人与晶体的组分或单颗铁屑之间的差异，并不像看上去那么大。“在我们的一切思考中，我们都被一些我们并不察觉的规则所引导（甚至被其操纵）。”
他承认“知识”这个说法本身就有误导性。“我们所谓的知识，”他指出，“首要地是一套行动规则的系统，并有指示各种刺激之等价、差异或种种组合的规则加以辅助和修正。”
我们遵循规则，不是因为它们基于更高的道德之善，也不是因为我们以推论得出了结论；我们遵循它们，是因为我们潜意识里观察到，它们“确保了实践这些规则的更多群体或个体得以存续”。
“人在思考之前就已行动，”哈耶克写道，“在行动之前并不理解。”
en: Hayek’s argument was that humans are not as dissimilar from the components of the crystal or the individual iron filings as they might seem. “In all our thinking, we are guided (or even operated) by rules of which we are not aware.”

He recognized that the term “knowledge” itself is misleading. “What we call knowledge,” he pointed out, “is primarily a system of rules of action assisted and modified by rules indicating equivalences or differences or various combinations of stimuli.”

We do not follow rules because they are based on a higher moral good nor because we have deduced our way to a conclusion; we follow them because we observe subconsciously that they have “secured that a greater number of the groups or individuals practicing them would survive.”
“Man acted before he thought,” Hayek wrote, “and did not understand before he acted.”

zh: 或许更准确的说法是：与其把哈耶克看作“经济人”（Homo economicus）观念的拥护者，不如把他看作“规则人”（
）观念的拥护者。人的第一条戒命不是最大化利润，而是依规则对刺激作出反应，以最大化存续的机会。在哈耶克看来，人是“遵循规则的动物”。
规则和价格一样，是指导个体的信号，往往在“超意识”的层面起作用。哈耶克的“神经—感官猜想”（neuro-sensory conjecture）已被赞同他的学者和批评他的学者同样深入地探讨过。
菲利普·米罗斯基（Philip Mirowski）所称的哈耶克的“无知生成学”（agnotology），在另一些学者的著作中得到了呼应——他们用经济行动者的“根本无知”这一预设，来解释哈耶克的模型为何与当代新古典经济学诸形态所蕴含的“理性搜寻”不相兼容。
en: It may be more accurate to see Hayek as more a proponent of the idea of
than of the idea of

The first commandment of humans is not to maximize profit but to react to stimuli according to rules in a way that will maximize the chance of survival. Humans, to Hayek, are “rules-following animals.”

Rules, like prices, are signals directing the individual, often at a “super-conscious” level. Hayek’s “neuro-sensory conjecture” has been explored deeply by scholars both sympathetic to and critical of his thinking.

What Philip Mirowski calls Hayek’s “agnotology” is echoed in the presumption of “radical ignorance” of economic actors in the work of those who seek to explain why Hayek’s model is incompatible with the “rational search” implied in contemporary forms of neoclassical economics.

zh: 如上所述种种隐喻所昭示的，在哈耶克笔下，能动性并不集中于一个主体。有学者谈到哈耶克对自由的“工具性辩护，据此，自由对于利用分散的、碎片化的、习惯性或默会的知识必不可少”。
在这一解读中，自由的存在是为了发现新的、更好的规则。主体的消失与系统论的一般取向是一致的：在系统论中，系统本身成了主角。如一位学者所说，哈耶克框架中“因果性的位置”不在个体，而是“似乎在于整张网或网络之中”。
另一位走得更远，说“唯一的主体处在人类与历史的整体系统这一层面”。
对哈耶克而言，自主的个体是一种表象，它依赖于自身与整体的关系——而整体又依赖于这一表象。
en: As the above metaphors make clear, the idea of agency is diffuse in Hayek’s work. One scholar speaks of Hayek’s “instrumental justification of liberty, [by which] freedom is essential for the utilization of dispersed, fragmented, and habitual or tacit knowledge.”

Freedom, in this reading, exists to discover new and better rules. The vanishing of the subject is consistent with system theory in general, where the system itself becomes the protagonist. As one scholar puts it, “the seat of causality” in Hayek’s framework is not the individual but “appears to be the entire web or network.”
Another goes even farther, saying that “the only subject is at the level of the whole system of humanity and history.”
To Hayek, the autonomous individual is an illusory effect dependent on its relation to the whole—which, in turn, is dependent on that illusory effect.

zh: 到现在应该已经清楚，哈耶克最著名的那个隐喻——“通往奴役之路”——本身就极不合哈耶克主义。道路这一隐喻并不常见于哈耶克的比喻中。他笔下更常见的是神经通路。他自己的隐喻和例子——晶体、云、铁屑、管道、配电盘——描绘的是复杂相互依赖的放射状与分支状网络，其特征是结果的不确定、知识的有限与能动性的有限，而不是意图明确的单一路径。在哈耶克看来，把一个拟人化的集体想象为在单一路径上有目的地行进，这本身就是一种认知的畸形——是对他的规范性秩序观念的倒转。他写道，“我们所谓民族或国家”的中央集权，“根本上出于使这一组织强大以进行战争的需要”。
换言之，问题不只是目的地——奴役——而且是隐喻本身的形式：把民族当作自主的行动者，当作社会生活的基本单元。
en: It should be clear by now that Hayek’s most famous metaphor—“the road to serfdom”—is itself strikingly un-Hayekian. The metaphor of the road is foreign to Hayek’s own cache, where the more common paths are neural. His own metaphors and examples—of crystals, clouds, iron filings, pipes, and switchboards—illustrate radial and branching networks of complex interdependence characterized by uncertain outcomes, limited knowledge, and limited agency, not single-path routes of intentionality. To Hayek, the idea of an anthropomorphized collective moving purposively on a single path is itself a cognitive monstrosity—the inversion of his normative idea of order. Centralization in “what we call a nation or a state,” he wrote, “is essentially the effect of the need of making this organization strong for war.”
The problem, in other words, is not just the destination—serfdom—but the form of the metaphor itself— the nation as an autonomous agent and the basic unit of social life.

zh: 哈耶克抱有这样一种信念：经济学家、专家与政策制定者只拥有有限的知识。在这一解读中，对秩序的首要威胁不是动物的、低层次的冲动，而是理性的、高层次的冲动。危险与其说是丛林法则，不如说是工程师法则。理性若被误用，就是秩序的敌人。因此，人们也许会以为控制论本身就是哈耶克所痛恨的“建构主义”（constructivism）的精髓。毕竟，“控制论”一词源于希腊语的“舵手”。但本书迄今的论述提示了另一种理解。
日内瓦学派的新自由主义者确实看到世界经济中存在一种有限形式的能动性。他们看到个体确实被国际分工的要求所“引导”。当世界市场正常运作时，它本身就是人类行动者的舵手。
en: Hayek subscribed to a belief that the economist, the expert, and the policy maker had only limited knowledge. In this reading, the primary threat to order is not animal, lower-level impulses but rational, higher-level impulses. The danger is not so much the law of the jungle as the law of the engineers. Reason, if misused, is the enemy of order. Therefore, one might think that cybernetics itself would be the essence of Hayek’s hated “constructivism”—coming from the Greek work for “steersman”—unless we acknowledge what my narrative has argued thus far.

Geneva School neoliberals did see a limited form of agency within the world economy. They saw individuals as indeed “steered” by the demands of the international division of labor. When functioning properly, the world market itself was the helmsman of human actors.

zh: 秩序自由主义的代表人物弗朗茨·伯姆追随哈耶克的控制论隐喻，以阐明这一图景。在他战后最重要的文本中，他写道：“市场价格体系……是社会所产出的所有信号系统中最具机械性或最精确的。”
他引用哈耶克论秩序的论述，写道：“评价的原则——请允许我借用自动化与控制论领域的一个说法——被编入符合该程序的操舵机制之中。理性而有序的发展之前提，是社会所有成员都以同样的方式从属于同一个操舵机制。”
哈耶克在一篇关键文章中写道，无论在“生物领域还是社会领域”，“自发秩序”之所以形成“有序的整体，是因为每一要素都依照确定的规则对其特定环境作出回应”。
en: Leading ordoliberal Franz Böhm followed Hayek’s cybernetic metaphors to help elucidate this vision. In his most important postwar text, he wrote that “the market price system … is of all the signaling systems produced by society the most mechanical or exact.

Citing Hayek on order, he wrote: “The principle of evaluation is, if I may draw on an expression from the field of automation and cybernetics, programmed into the steering mechanism which conforms to the program. The precondition for rational and orderly development is that all members of society are subordinated to the same steering mechanism in the same way.”

Within both the “biological and social sphere,” Hayek wrote in a key article, “spontaneous orders” form as “orderly wholes because each element responds to its particular environment in accordance with definite rules.”

zh: 对哈耶克、伯姆以及所有追随他们的新自由主义者来说，与系统整体之再生产最相关的信息是价格。哈耶克在一次访谈中说，马克思主义的一个错误在于把价格看作生产某种物品所投入劳动的反映。实际上，价格之所以重要，首先在于他用控制论术语所称的“负反馈效应”（negative feedback effect）。他说：“价格的功能是告诉人们应当做什么。”
我们不妨把哈耶克哲学的核心取为这段话：“表面上的悖论在于：在市场中，正是通过系统地使某些期待落空，各种预期从总体上看才得到了如此有效的满足。这就是‘负反馈’原理运作的方式。”
哈耶克在此暴露了许多东西。最终被赋予特权的是整体，而非个体。不正义是系统的一个功能性要求。他写道，“本不该遭遇的厄运”是“市场操舵机制不可分割的一部分：这正是控制论的负反馈原理用以维持市场秩序的方式”。
en: For Hayek, Böhm, and all neoliberals who followed, the most relevant information for the reproduction of the system as a whole is prices. As Hayek put it in an interview, one of Marxism’s errors was to see prices as reflective of the labor invested in an object. Actually, prices are important primarily for what he called, using a term from cybernetics, their “negative feedback effect.” “The function of prices,” he said, “is to tell people what they ought to do.”

We could take the core of Hayek’s philosophy to be this: “The apparent paradox that in the market it is through the systematic disappointment of some expectations that on the whole expectations are as effectively met as they are. This is the manner in which the principle of ‘negative feedback’ operates.”

Hayek reveals much in this passage. What is privileged in the end is not the individual but the whole. Injustice is a functional requirement of the system. “Underserved strokes of misfortune,” he wrote, are “an inseparable part of the steering mechanism of the market: it is the manner in which the cybernetic principle of negative feedback operates to maintain the order of the market.”

zh: “本不该遭遇的厄运”的不可预知性，反而加大了个体必须尽可能敏锐地回应价格信号的压力。通过这一对危险的关注，可以更好地理解企业家形象为何对新自由主义者具有中心意义。勒普克（Röpke）在1947年一篇论企业家的短文中，把企业家描述为“极为复杂的市场经济过程中的一个枢纽：他接收消费者发给他的脉冲，并将其转化为相应的生产类型与生产规模”。在一个值得大段引用的非凡隐喻中，勒普克写道，企业家坐在“一台配电盘前，千股电流汇入其中，又被以另一个方向、另一种形式送出……个体企业家的私人经济命运取决于这台配电盘的正确操作……而恰恰是这种依赖……提供了最好的保证：他会尽责、勤勉而明智地操作这台配电盘，正如我们把同样的信任托付给一台复杂电力机车的司机，因为我们知道列车的命运同时也就是他自己的命运”。
企业家身处险境，拿他人的性命冒险，也因此拿自己的性命冒险。勒普克写道，企业家“从属于市场的主权”。
en: The very arbitrariness of “undeserved strokes of misfortune” increased the pressure on the individual to be as responsive as possible to price signals. The centrality of the figure of the entrepreneur for neoliberals can be understood better through this focus on danger. In a short piece on the entrepreneur from 1947, Röpke described the entrepreneur as “the node in the enormously complicated process of the market economy: he receives the impulses that the consumers send to him and translates them into the corresponding type and volume of production.” In an extraordinary metaphor worth quoting at length, Röpke writes that the entrepreneur sits “at a switchgear into which a thousand currents enter to be sent out again in another direction and another form. The private economic fate of the individual entrepreneur depends on the correct operation of this switchgear … and it is precisely this dependency … that offers the best guarantee that he will operate the switchgear as conscientiously, zealously, and intelligently as the engineer of a complicated electric locomotive whom we offer the same trust and confidence because we know that the fate of the train is, at the same time, also his own.”
By living dangerously, the entrepreneur risks the lives of others and therein risks his own life. Entrepreneurs, Röpke wrote, are “subordinated to the sovereignty of the market.”

zh: 尽管哈耶克贬低“工程师”——在科学家自以为拥有足够的全局视野、能亲手建造整个系统这一意义上——他却称赞“工程师”——在火车司机这一意义上，理由与勒普克相似。他1945年写道，价格体系是“一种记录变动的机器，或一套电信系统，它使个体生产者只需盯住几根指针的动向，正如机车司机盯着几只仪表的指针，以此来调整自己的活动”。
在一个几乎完全相同的1941年隐喻中，工程师变成了“个体企业家，他仿佛可以从几只仪表上、用简单的数字读出系统内任何地方所发生的一切的相关结果”。
通过把自己的能动性缩减为对刺激的回应，并身处驾驭飞驰机车、轰鸣电站或资本主义企业的不安定位置，工程师与企业家成为价格体系线路中最理想的开关。
en: Although Hayek disparaged the engineer in the sense of the scientist who believes she has sufficient overview of an entire system to build it herself, he praised the engineer in the sense of the train engineer, for reasons similar to Röpke’s. He wrote in 1945 that “the price system [is] a kind of machinery for registering change, or a system of telecommunications which enables individual producers to watch merely the movement of a few pointers, as an engineer might watch the hands of a few dials, in order to adjust their activities.”

In a near-identical metaphor from 1941, the engineer was instead “the individual entrepreneur [who] can read off, as it were, from a few gauges and in simple figures, the relevant results of everything which happens anywhere in the system.”

The engineer and the entrepreneur became the ideal switches in the circuitry of the price system by reducing their agency to the response to stimuli in the precarious position of guiding a hurtling locomotive, churning power plant, or capitalist enterprise.

zh: 有了以上虽冗长却必要的疏解，就应该清楚为什么国际经济新秩序在哈耶克的意义上构不成一种秩序。秩序不是靠规定目标与期待的终态来维系的。相反，秩序的维系要求个体——以及国家——服从系统的智慧。对哈耶克而言，理性的最高形式就是服从制度所蕴含、超出个人所知的知识，而制度本身正是长期自然选择过程判定为成功的策略的累积。必要的无知必须得到保存。
en: Given the above lengthy but necessary exegesis, it should be clear why the NIEO would not constitute an order in Hayek’s sense. Order is not perpetuated by prescribing goals and desired end-states. Instead, the perpetuation of order requires that individuals—and states—defer to the wisdom of the system. For Hayek, the highest form of rationality is surrender to the greater knowledge of institutions, which are themselves the accretion of successful strategies determined through long-term processes of natural selection. The necessary ignorance must be preserved.

zh: 然而，这给那位急于干预的行动派新自由主义知识分子留下了什么位置？1977年，朝圣山学社会员詹姆斯·M.·布坎南（James M. Buchanan）抱怨说，“像哈耶克似乎所做的那样，暗示既不存在、也不应当存在评价现有制度的准则，在我看来，这在现代情境中是一句劝人放弃努力的话。”
约翰·格雷（John Gray）认为，哈耶克是要我们“把自己托付给人类在历史空间中随机漫步的一切反复无常”。
哈耶克版本的系统论是否真的规定了一种面对市场的静默主义？在一个由“超意识”规则与有限知识构成的系统里，明显的偏离应当如何纠正？这些问题在1970年代末达到顶点，当时新自由主义者目睹了其中两人所谓“世界贸易秩序的动摇”——那就是国际经济新秩序，以及工业化国家转向“新保护主义”：自愿出口限制、有序销售安排，以及一大批他们解读为贸易壁垒的其他措施。
颇有意思的是，重审帝国之后干预之可能性——名义上是为了反对干预主义——的一个关键机会，出现在大英帝国最后的遗存之一：英国直辖殖民地（crown colony）香港。
en: Yet where does this leave the activist neoliberal intellectual who is eager to intervene? In 1977 fellow MPS member James M. Buchanan complained that “to imply, as Hayek seems to do, that there neither exists nor should exist a guideline for evaluating existing institutions seems to me to be a counsel of despair in the modern setting.”
John Gray contended that Hayek asks us to “entrust ourselves to all the vagaries of mankind’s random walk in historical space.”

Does Hayek’s version of system theory really prescribe a kind of quietism in the face of the market? How should apparent deviations be corrected in a system of “super-conscious” rules and limited knowledge? These questions came to a head in the late 1970s as neoliberals witnessed what two of them called “the undermining of the world trade order” in the NIEO and the move of industrialized nations to the “new protectionism” of voluntary export restraints, orderly marketing arrangements, and a whole host of other measures they read as barriers to trade.

Interestingly enough, a key opportunity to revisit the chances for postimperial intervention—putatively against interventionism—came in one of the last remnants of the British Empire, in the crown colony of Hong Kong.

zh: 有意设计的微妙界限

children: THE THIN LINE OF DELIBERATE DESIGN

zh: 1978年9月在香港举行的朝圣山学社会议，是该社第一次在欧洲和北美之外召开的全体大会。它的特别之处还在于，这为提前庆祝学社首任会长——哈耶克本人——八十寿辰提供了机会。
香港以某种基本形态示范了新自由主义的解决方案：一种不受多数决支配的市场经济模式，在限定人民主权的同时最大化资本主权，配以大肆宣扬的自由贸易政策、严格的银行保密法和低公司税率。在许多方面，香港正是1970年代国际经济新秩序与全球南方诉求的倒置版本。一位讲者在1974年的一次朝圣山学社会议上观察到，由于“暴露而依附的经济与政治处境”，香港不得不维持“一种便于投资获利的环境”。
当阿根廷经济学家劳尔·普雷维什（Raúl Prebisch）和联合国拉丁美洲经济委员会（ECLA，拉美经委会）把“依附”理论化为一种应当摆脱的负面状态时，新自由主义者却公开把它开成处方，用以使各国服从哈耶克在其香港演讲的刊行版本中所称的“自由的规训”（the discipline of freedom）。
既没有代议制政府，香港又处于殖民地位（其土地甚至全部归公有），但这一切都不曾妨碍一位报道该会议的新闻记者把香港描述为“当今世界上最称得上自由至上（libertarian）的主要文明共同体”。
事实上，令人赞佩的是它对民主这一扰攘难题的解决。
en: The MPS meeting in Hong Kong in September 1978 was its first general meeting outside of Europe and North America. It was special also because it offered a chance for an early celebration of the eightieth birthday of the society’s first president, Hayek himself.

Hong Kong was a remarkable example of the neoliberal fix in a basic form: a model of nonmajoritarian market economy that limited popular sovereignty while maximizing capital sovereignty with a much-touted free-trade policy, a robust bank secrecy law, and a low corporate tax rate. In many ways Hong Kong was the inverted version of the demands of the NIEO and the Global South in the 1970s. One speaker at a 1974 MPS meeting observed that because of its “exposed and dependent economic and political situation,” Hong Kong was compelled to maintain “an environment conducive to profitable investment.”

While Argentine economist Raúl Prebisch and the United Nations Economic Commission for Latin America (ECLA) theorized “dependency” as a negative state to be escaped, neoliberals openly prescribed it as a means of subjecting states to what Hayek called in the published version of his Hong Kong talk “the discipline of freedom.”

Neither the absence of representative government nor Hong Kong’s colonial status (nor, for that matter, the public ownership of all land) deterred a journalist covering the meeting from describing Hong Kong as “the most libertarian major civilized community in the world today.”
What was admirable, in fact, was its solution to the disruptive problem of democracy.

zh: 就在朝圣山学社于香港开会之际，中国共产党也在筹划中华人民共和国自己的制度解决方案。当时，整个中国大陆的出口额还不超过香港这一小小殖民地。邓小平的改革开启了一个朝向中国自身那种非多数决资本主义的过程，缓慢地引入市场自由而不扩大政治代表。价格机制获准存在，而人民主权的机制——多党选举——则没有。1979年，中国在珠江三角洲开放了全国第一批出口加工区；这一在国家税收结构之外的例外区域，到1990年代成为新自由主义式发展的一个界定性形态。
en: Even as the MPS met in Hong Kong, the Chinese Communist Party was planning its own institutional fix for the People’s Republic of China. At the time, mainland China as a whole exported no more than the tiny colony of Hong Kong. Deng Xiaoping’s reforms started a process toward China’s own form of nonmajoritarian capitalism, slowly introducing market freedoms without expanding political representation. The price mechanism was permitted without the mechanism of popular sovereignty—the multiparty election. In 1979, China opened the country’s first export processing zones in the Pearl River Delta, a region of exception outside of the national tax structure that would become a defining form of neoliberal-style development by the 1990s.

zh: 然而，这一未来在1970年代还很遥远，而在国际经济新秩序成为议题的这十年里，形势在新自由主义者看来依然险恶。朝圣山学社社长乔治·斯蒂格勒（George Stigler）在香港发表的演讲题为《社会主义者为何屡占上风？》。他所看到的主要问题，与德国新自由主义者自1930年代以来、美国公共选择理论家自1960年代以来一直在诊断的民主难题如出一辙：“政治过程强烈地偏向集体主义。”
鉴于新自由主义立场可能已成为“少数人的观点”，斯蒂格勒问道：“如果事实上我们追求的正是许多人所不愿要的，那么把这一点纳入考量，转而寻求那些能让我们追求自身目标的政治制度与政策，我们不是会更为成功吗？”
他指出一处亮色：第13号提案（Proposition 13），那是当年加利福尼亚州通过的一项立法，它对财产税设定了上限，并要求任何州税收措施都须三分之二多数方可通过。
en: This future was distant in the 1970s, however, and in the decade of the NIEO, the situation still looked dire to neoliberals. The Hong Kong address presented by MPS president George Stigler was titled “Why Have the Socialists Been Winning?” The main problem he saw was the same conundrum of democracy that German neoliberals had been diagnosing since the 1930s and American public choice theorists since the 1960s: the “political process is strongly biased toward collectivism.”

Given the possibility that the neoliberal position had become a “minority view,” Stigler asked: “If in fact we seek what many do not wish, will we not be more successful if we take this into account and seek political institutions and policies that allow us to pursue our own goals?”

He identified a bright spot in Proposition 13, a piece of legislation passed in California that year that put a limit on property taxes and required a two-thirds majority to pass any state revenue measures.

zh: 斯蒂格勒的演讲发表在最重要的新自由主义刊物《秩序》（Ordo）上。这标志着新自由主义对制度形式之搜寻加速的一个转折点：这种制度形式既要顾及民主现实，又要锁定亲市场的结果。在同一期中，布坎南在一篇题为《对政府征税权的宪政约束》的文章里，提出了与第13号提案类似的措施方案。
在美国这样一个联邦制国家，税改的优势在于同样的原理同样适用——正是这一原理使香港成为经商乐土——即州政府创造出更具吸引力的投资环境，从而促使人们“用脚投票，或者用其可流动的资源投票”。
在香港会议上，威廉·H.·哈特会见了哈耶克邀请的几位南非人。或许正是受斯蒂格勒呼吁精修新自由主义方案的启发，会后他给南非财政部长写了一封七页单倍行距的信，勾勒出按个人纳税等级给选民的选票赋予不同权重的方案。
en: Stigler’s address was published in the leading neoliberal journal,

It marked a turning point in the acceleration of the neoliberal search for institutional forms that would account for democratic realities but nonetheless lock in market-friendly outcomes. In the same issue, Buchanan laid out a plan for measures similar to Proposition 13 in an article titled “Constitutional Constraints on Governmental Taxing Power.”

The advantage of tax reform in a federal state like the United States meant that the same principle applied that made Hong Kong a successful place of business—the state creates a more attractive investment climate that will encourage people “to vote with their feet, or with their mobile resources.”

At the Hong Kong meeting W. H. Hutt met several South Africans invited by Hayek. It was after the meeting, perhaps inspired by Stigler’s call for refinements of the neoliberal fix, that he wrote a seven-page single-space letter to the South African finance minister outlining his plan for weighting the franchise according to one’s individual tax bracket.

zh: 从表面上看，哈耶克的演讲对斯蒂格勒所呼吁的制度设计帮助不大。与第13号提案不同，它没有要求为立法设置更高的门槛，也没有约束各州不得进行再分配。与哈特关于加权选举权的主张不同，它没有提供任何把财富与民主权力连接起来的路线图。然而细加审视，一位香港会议参与者所称的哈耶克对“社会生物学的批判”之中，却包含了把他的工作应用于全球经济治理蓝图的线索。
哈耶克的论文题为《人类价值的三个来源》，作为《自由社会的政治秩序》（
of a Free People）的跋发表，该书是他1970年代三部曲《法律、立法与自由》（
Liberty）的最后一卷。他以对当时复杂系统理论的直接介入开篇，指责E. O. 威尔逊（E. O. Wilson）一类的社会生物学家只看到人类价值的两个来源：基因与人类理性。哈耶克提出了第三个来源，即不依赖基因或理性的文化积淀。他将它理解为“一种由习得的行为规则构成的传统。这些规则从来不是人为发明的，照此行事的人通常也不理解它们的功能”。
en: On the face of it, Hayek’s talk had little to offer to Stigler’s call for institutional design. Unlike Proposition 13, it made no call for higher bars for legislation or for binding states from redistribution. Unlike Hutt’s proposal for weighted franchise, it offered no road map to link wealth to democratic power. Yet on closer examination, what one participant in the Hong Kong meeting called Hayek’s “critique of sociobiology” contained clues about the application of his work to blueprints for global economic governance.
Hayek’s paper was titled “The Three Sources of Human Values” and was published as the epilogue to
the final book of his 1970s trilogy,

He opened with a direct engagement with contemporary theories of complex systems, charging that sociobiologists like E. O. Wilson saw only two sources of human values: genes and human reason. Hayek made the case for a third term in the nongenetic, nonrational reservoir of culture, interpreted as “a tradition of learnt rules of conduct which have never been invented and whose functions the acting individuals usually do not understand.”

zh: 学者们正确地强调了演化规则、自发性与“演化形成的秩序”（grown order）在哈耶克思想中的中心地位。
然而他们常常忽略一个事实：哈耶克并没有用一对（基因／传统）去替换另一对（基因／理性）。他坚持认为存在“三层规则”。第一层是无意识的、相对恒定的生理本能规则；第二层是无意识的、后天习得的传统规则；第三层则“凌乎这一切之上”，是“为已知目的而有意识地采纳或修改的规则构成的那一薄层”。
前两层规则不为人知，更接近他所谓的“规律性”，我们无意识地遵循它们，正如铁屑顺从磁铁。但最上层那“薄薄一层”规则由“有意设计的产物构成：这些是我们通过运用理性制定的规则，而我们‘必须被要求遵守它们’”。
en: Scholars rightly emphasize the centrality of evolutionary rules, spontaneity, and “grown order” in Hayek’s thought.

Yet they often miss the fact that Hayek did not replace one pair (genes / reason) with another (genes / tradition). There were “three layers of rules,” he insisted. In the first layer were the unconscious, and relatively constant, instinctive rules of physiology; in the second were the unconscious and acquired rules of tradition; and the third layer, “on top of all this,” was “the thin layer of rules deliberately adopted or modified to serve known purposes.”

The first two layers of rules were unknown, more akin to “regularity,” as he put it, and we follow them unconsciously, just as an iron filing follows the magnet. But the uppermost, “thin layer” of rules consisted of “the products of deliberate design: these were the rules we made through the application of our reason and which we ‘have to be made to obey.’ ”

zh: 哈耶克把行为规则三分层，这既解释个体认知，也解释整个社会系统。和他的许多模型一样，这一模型可以轻易地切换尺度。1960年他自己就已把心智与社会作类比：“正如支配个体心智的力量，成就社会秩序的力量也分属多个层级”；“明晰表述的规则”之所以能起作用，只是因为它们运行在未言明的“共同信念”的基岩之上。
哈耶克在弗赖堡讲席的继任者指出，哈耶克保留了“法律意义上的个体行为规则”，视其为“一个规则分层的顶层，该分层同时也包括本能驱动与传统”。
把已知的、有意设计的、明晰表述的规则框定为“薄层”或“仅仅是顶层”，可能给人以它们可有可无或无足轻重之感。然而，尽管哈耶克确实着重强调了未言明的规则，同样真实的是，若没有层级顶端那“薄层”明晰规则，他的整个系统就会坍塌，人类将与白蚁无异。无论多么“薄”，有意识的规则层对于再生产社会秩序本身都是必需的。即使容许有意设计的范围很窄，这层规则也是哈耶克整个系统的关键。抽掉它，秩序就会瓦解。
en: Hayek’s tripartite stratification of the rules of conduct explained both individual cognition and the social system as a whole. Like many of his models, this one could easily shift scales. In 1960 he himself had drawn the analogy between the mind and society: “Like the forces governing the individual mind, the forces making for social order are a multilevel affair”; “articulated rules” could work only because they operated on the bedrock of unspoken “common beliefs.”

Hayek’s successor in the chair at Freiburg noted that Hayek retained “rules of individual conduct in the sense of law” as “the top layer of a stratification of rules which also comprises instinctive drives and tradition.”

The framing of the known, deliberately designed, and articulated rules as a “thin layer” or “only the top layer” can give the impression that they are dispensable or negligible. Yet while it is true that Hayek’s primary intervention was to emphasize the unspoken rules, it is equally true that without the “thin layer” of articulated rules at the top of the hierarchy, his whole system would fall apart and humans would be equivalent to termites. No matter how “thin,” the layer of conscious rules is necessary to reproduce social order as such. However slender it might be, what we might call Hayek’s thin line of deliberate design is the lynchpin of the whole system. Pull it out and order dissolves.

zh: 毫无疑问，哈耶克对设计的大多数提及都是负面的，尤其是他一再坚持秩序是“人类行动的结果而非人类设计的产物”。但必须指出，他所攻击的是完全设计的企图。在1970年代那部三部曲的开篇几页，他坦率地把自己的规划描述为一种“宪政设计”。
尽管规则的顶层也许是薄的，哈耶克却视之为人类真正能够介入的唯一所在：“我们此后的主要兴趣将在于那些规则，亦即因为我们可以有意改变它们、从而成为我们影响所生成秩序之主要工具的规则，也就是法律规则。”
en: It is beyond question that most of Hayek’s references to design are negative, especially in his repeated insistence that orders that are “the products of human action but not human design.” But it is essential to note that what he attacks are attempts to design completely. He describes his own project frankly as one of “constitutional design” in the first pages of his 1970s trilogy.
Though the top layer of rules may be thin, Hayek viewed it as the only place where humans can actually intervene: “Our main interest will then be those rules which, because we can de
become the chief instrument whereby we can affect the resulting order, namely the rules of law.”

zh: 这里不妨回到哲学家加勒特·哈丁（Garrett Hardin）在1969年一篇文章中对规划与设计所作的区分，哈耶克在其香港论文中引用了此文。哈丁把规划定义为“制定相当细致、相当僵化的计划”。他所称的设计，则是“对一个包含负反馈与自我矫正控制的控制论系统，作出宽松得多、细节少得多的规定”。他还补充说，“古典市场经济就是这样一种设计。”
无论哈耶克在这一点上是否直接受哈丁启发，这一区分都有助于澄清他的著述。不难论证，尤其在1970年代，哈耶克所从事的是一项系统设计计划。哈耶克的模型是一个由原则支撑的经济。哈耶克称这些原则为“正当行为规则”（rules of just conduct）。其来源包括生理机制、累积的人类传统，以及人们能够采取行动的那一小块领域，即有意设计所及的范围。
en: It is helpful here to return to a distinction between planning and design offered by the philosopher Garrett Hardin in a 1969 article cited by Hayek in his Hong Kong paper. Hardin defined planning as “the making of rather detailed, rather rigid plans.” By designing, he meant “much looser, less detailed, specification of a cybernetic system which includes negative feedbacks, self-correcting controls.” He added that “the classical market economy is such a design.”

Whether or not Hayek was inspired by Hardin directly on this point, the distinction helps clarify his writings. It is not difficult to argue that in the 1970s in particular, what Hayek is engaged in was a project of system design. Hayek’s model is an economy of principles, or “rules of just conduct,” as he called them, derived from physiology, the accretion of human tradition and—the site of action—the thin line of deliberate design.

zh: 因此，把哈耶克1970年代的著述说成是注定我们只能像格雷所说的那样“随机漫步”，是一种误导。哈耶克白纸黑字地说：“协作将永远同时依赖于自发秩序与有意组织”，并把自身的规划本身标明为一种设计。
在许多学者那里，哈耶克对秩序的演化性、自发性和无意识面向的关注，可能使人忽略硬法围封着宇宙的事实。正确地理解，哈耶克的意思并非我们根本不能设计社会系统；而是我们无法完全地设计社会系统——而且我们必须设计其中的一部分。
en: It is thus misleading to characterize Hayek’s writings from the 1970s as condemning us to, as Gray put it, “a random walk.” Hayek says in black and white that “collaboration will always rest both on spontaneous order as well as on deliberate organization” and labels his project one itself of design.

For many scholars, Hayek’s focus on the evolutionary, spontaneous, and unconscious aspects of order can distract from the fact that hard law encases the cosmos. Understood correctly, Hayek’s meaning is not that we cannot design the social system
it is that we cannot design the social system
—and that we
design part of it.

zh: 在同一卷的末尾，哈耶克提供了一个明确的例子，说明这种思维如何可以移用到全球层面。他1930年代与1940年代关于联邦制的著述常被讨论，但他在1970年代对这一主题的回归几乎完全未获学界注意。1979年，在呼吁“政治退位”（the dethronement of politics）的一节中，哈耶克写道：“在这个世纪，我们创立一个能够保障和平的国际政府的努力，一般是从错误的一端切入任务的：创建大量以特定规制为目标的专门机构，而不是求建立真正的国际法，以限制各国政府相互伤害的权力。如果最高层的共同价值是否定性的，那么不仅最高层的共同规则，而且最高层的权威，基本上都应当仅限于禁令。”
哈耶克在此给出了一个指示，说明他那些自战争结束以来大体沉寂的国际秩序理论如何能够放大到全球尺度。一批新自由主义者正是在日内瓦通过复兴哈耶克的思想做了这件事。他们以七十七国集团自身的武器回敬七十七国集团，其应对国际经济新秩序的办法是“以法律对抗法律”。关贸总协定的改革将部分地成为一个在世界尺度上进行哈耶克式系统设计的实验室。
en: At the end of the same volume, Hayek provides an explicit example of how this thinking might be transposed to the global level. Though his writings on federation from the 1930s and 1940s are often discussed, his return to the topic in the 1970s has all but escaped scholarly attention. In 1979, in a section calling for “the dethronement of politics,” Hayek wrote, “In this century our attempts to create an inter-national government capable of assuring peace have generally approached the task from the wrong end: creating large numbers of specialized authorities aiming at particular regulations rather than aiming at a true interna

which would limit the powers of national governments to harm each other. If the highest common values are negative, not only the highest common rules but also the highest authority should essentially be

Hayek offered here an indication of how his theories on international order, more or less dormant since the end of the war, could be scaled up to the global. A cadre of neoliberals would do just that by reviving Hayek’s thought in Geneva. Retaliating against the G-77 with its own weapons, their solution to the NIEO was to fight law with law. The reform of the GATT would become, in part, a laboratory for Hayekian system design at the scale of the world.

zh: 作为系统错误的国际经济新秩序

1977年，也就是香港朝圣山学社会议召开的前一年，关贸总协定迁入一座新近更名为“威廉·拉帕德中心”（Centre William Rappard）的大楼。此名取自1930至1940年代日内瓦高等国际问题研究院（Graduate Institute for International Studies）里新自由主义知识运动的那位推手，他的富有家庭当初捐赠了这块地皮。新住客最早着手做的事情之一，就是拆除并遮蔽这座建筑此前作为国际劳工组织（ILO）总部时装饰其间的壁画与瓷砖画。迪安·康威尔（Dean Cornwell）的一幅壁画被卷起来塞进了一间园丁小屋；该画由美国劳工联合会（American Federation of Labor）于1956年捐赠，画面描绘女秘书站在成排的卡片目录柜前，画面还有铜管乐队与小学教师。这些形象分布在中央图像两旁：一位袒露胸膛、身系钢铁工人皮围裙的工人，手腕上悬着砸断的镣铐。
亚麻墙面板下面藏匿着古斯塔夫-路易·若姆（Gustave-Louis Jaulme）应国际劳工组织委托于1939年创作的壁画，画中人物身着飘逸长袍、手持棕榈枝列队行进，采摘果实，或在凉亭花架下憩息。
被抹去的还有一件由荷兰工会1926年捐赠的代尔夫特瓷砖作品，其上以四种语言呈现《凡尔赛条约》中关于劳动尊严的条文，环绕着一位风格化的红衣男性工人，他正在垒建战后世界秩序的支柱。世界贸易组织总干事帕斯卡尔·拉米后来谈及这批艺术品的移除时打趣道：“这就好比你在一处社会住房小区里接手移民原来住的地方。”这番玩笑暗示了被取代的那种世界经济秩序愿景所承受的种族化归类。
在1977年时任关贸总协定总干事的奥利维耶·隆（Olivier Long）看来，这些艺术与他那个贸易组织的精神不相兼容。
正如我们将看到的，关贸总协定的世界经济不是由劳动、肉身、辛劳与闲暇构成的经济，而是由价格信号与规则构成的经济；用隆在1978年的宣示来说，这是一个“重申国际贸易中的法治”的世界。
en: In 1977, the year before the Hong Kong MPS meeting, the GATT moved into a building newly renamed the Centre William Rappard after the impresario of the neoliberal intellectual movement at the Graduate Institute for International Studies in the 1930s and 1940s, whose wealthy family had originally donated the land. One of the first activities of the new occupants was to remove and cover over murals and tilework that had decorated the building in its previous function as the seat of the International Labour Organization (ILO). Rolled up and stashed in a gardener’s cottage was a mural by Dean Cornwell; donated by the American Federation of Labor in 1956, the mural depicted female secretaries at walls of card catalogues, brass bands, and elementary schoolteachers flanking a central image of a bare-chested worker in an ironworker’s apron, broken shackles dangling from his wrists.

Concealed beneath linen wall panels were murals by Gustave-Louis Jaulme commissioned by the ILO in 1939 depicting figures parading in flowing garments holding palm fronds, gathering fruit, and relaxing beneath bowers.

Also effaced was a work of Delft tiles donated by Dutch trade unions in 1926 depicting the passage from the Versailles Treaty about the dignity of labor, translated into four languages, surrounding a stylized male worker clad in red who was building the pillars of world order after the war. Suggesting the racialization of the alternative vision of the world economic order that was replaced, WTO director-general Pascal Lamy quipped later about the art’s removal: “It’s a bit as if you took over from immigrants in a social housing development.”
To the GATT’s director-general Olivier Long in 1977, the art was incompatible with the spirit of his trade organization.

As we will see, rather than a world economy of labor, bodies, toil, and leisure, the GATT’s world economy was one of price signals, rules, and, as Long declared in 1978, the “reaffirmation of the rule of law in international trade.”

zh: 迁址之际，关贸总协定正置身于一份报告所称的“日内瓦的秘密战争”之中：所谓的东京回合谈判（1973—1979年）试图为帝国时代终结之后、战后经济秩序的关键部分瓦解之后的时代，重新构想这一世界贸易机构。1971年，美国单方面停止以美元兑换黄金，布雷顿森林体系就此以其原始形态告终。到1973年，部分出于哈伯勒及其他新自由主义者勤勉游说的成效，美国让美元“浮动”，让市场需求（连同有针对性的国家干预）决定其价值。
随之，世界上许多货币也相继浮动，开启了从浮动汇率到“有管理的浮动”等各类货币策略并存的时期。与此同时，国际货币基金组织不再授权实施资本流动管制，1930年代的“热钱”流动于是复现，而全球电信联系的增强又使其规模大为放大。
新的投资流动向世界各国开放，但如果外国投资者不赞成诸如通过加税来建设国内福利国家之类高成本政策，资本外逃也可能构成一种惩罚。
在哈伯勒这样的新自由主义者看来，这种约束反而有益，因为它迫使发达国家把“维持汇率稳定视为高于其他一切考虑的事情”。
香港这类地区面临的不稳定处境，可以而且应当成为后布雷顿森林时代新自由主义世界的范式。
en: At the time of its relocation, the GATT was in the midst of what one report called “Geneva’s secret war” as the so-called Tokyo Round of negotiations (1973–1979) sought to rethink the world trade institution for an era after empire and after the dissolution of key parts of the postwar economic order. In 1971 the Bretton Woods system had ended in its original form when the United States unilaterally ceased exchanging dollars for gold. By 1973, responding in part to the diligent persuasion of Haberler and other neoliberals, the States let the dollar “float,” allowing market demand (alongside targeted state interventions) to dictate its value.

In turn, many of the world’s currencies floated too, launching an era of a variety of monetary strategies ranging from flexible exchange rates to “managed floating.” Simultaneously, the end of IMF authorization for controls on capital movements brought back the “hot money” flows of the 1930s, amplified in volume by the greater global connectivity of telecommunications.

New investment flows were available to nations worldwide, but capital flight could also be punitive if foreign investors disapproved of costly policies like building domestic welfare states through higher taxation.

Neoliberals like Haberler saw the constraint as salutary because it compelled developed nations to see “the maintenance of exchange stability as something which must take precedence over all other considerations.”
The precariousness of a territory like Hong Kong could and should be paradigmatic for a post–Bretton Woods neoliberal world.

zh: 表面上看，关贸总协定不太可能是新自由主义法律“反革命”的策源地。尽管其历任总干事都受过法律专业训练，日内瓦偏好的方式仍是经济外交与临时个案谈判。直到1983年，关贸总协定甚至还没有一个法律事务办公室——彼时世界银行已经雇有一百名律师。
局面的改变始于接受日内瓦训练的律师奥利维耶·隆出任总干事之后。1978年，隆在伦敦的智库贸易政策研究中心（TPRC）的一次演讲中首次援引“法治”一词；该中心由澳大利亚经济学家休·科贝特（Hugh Corbet）创立于1968年。
隆赞同美国律师约翰·H.·杰克逊（John H. Jackson）前一年在同一中心另一次演讲中提出的建议，即必须发展出某种办法，以阻止各国政府“无视或绕开关贸总协定规则”的倾向。
en: On its face the GATT was an unlikely spot for a neoliberal legal counterrevolution. Although all of its directors were lawyers by training, the preferred mode in Geneva was economic diplomacy and ad hoc negotiation. GATT did not even have an office of legal affairs until 1983, at a time when the World Bank already employed one hundred lawyers.

The situation began to change first under the directorship of the Geneva-trained lawyer Olivier Long. In 1978 Long first invoked the term “rule of law” in a speech at a London-based think tank, the Trade Policy Research Centre (TPRC), founded by Australian economist Hugh Corbet in 1968.

Long endorsed the proposal made the previous year in another speech at the TPRC by the American lawyer John H. Jackson, on the need to develop some way to stop the tendency of governments to “disregard or side-step GATT rules.”

zh: 杰克逊1969年写就了通常被称为“关贸总协定圣经”的著作，整个1970年代他与美国国际法学会合作，加固他所说的关贸总协定“脆弱的宪法基础”，挽救“正在坍塌的自由贸易体制诸机构”。
他也被誉为当代贸易法的开创者以及国际经济法领域最重要的人物。

杰克逊看到规则秩序遭受侵蚀的两个主要源头。一面是北方工业化国家利用一整套“新保护主义”措施来抵挡日本等新兴经济体的竞争；另一面是大批新近摆脱殖民统治的国家“在许多采用一国一票表决制的组织中占多数”，并利用这种地位谋取豁免，逃脱规则体制的约束。把民主原则提升到国际治理层面，看似一桩善举，在杰克逊眼中却是秩序的障碍。“在今天，任何以一国一票制为程序基础的国际机构，几乎没有可能发展出实质性的规则制定权。”他说。
en: Jackson, who in 1969 had written what is often called the “GATT bible,” worked with the American Society of International Law in the 1970s to shore up what he called the “flimsy constitutional basis” of the GATT and salvage “the crumbling institutions of the liberal trade system.”
He was also credited as the inventor of contemporary trade law and the single most important figure in international economic law.

Jackson saw two main sources of erosion of the rules-based order. On the one hand, industrialized Northern countries were using a host of “neo-protectionist” measures to fend off competition from rising economies like Japan; on the other hand, the vast group of newly decolonized nations enjoyed “their current majority status in many organizations, when voting proceeds on a one-nation one-vote system” and used it to secure exemptions from the rule-based regime. What might appear as a salutary scaling up of the democratic principle to the level of international governance was an obstacle to order for Jackson. “There is virtually no chance of significant rule-making authority developing in any international body today,” he said, “which bases its procedures on the one-nation one-vote system.”

zh: 杰克逊把矛头指向发展中国家——就贸易体量而言还只是相对次要的角色——看似错置了靶心。然而，这恰恰是1970年代新兴的国际经济法领域与关贸总协定改革运动的典型象征。发展中国家的世界经济想象——以联合国贸易和发展会议（贸发会议，UNCTAD）和七十七国集团为代表——正是界定关贸总协定改革时所对照的那个“他者”。其原因并非（或不只是）赤裸裸的新殖民主义或文化优越论，而是对全球南方在1960年代赢得的那些让步的反扑。凭借有说服力的知识生产、有效的外交和集体动员，全球南方国家先是争得所谓的第四部分（Part IV，1966年），继而争得普遍优惠制（1971年），实际上使自己摆脱了关贸总协定的纪律约束。这正是后来所谓世界贸易体制中对发展中国家的“特殊与差别待遇”的核心所在。
en: Jackson’s targeting of the developing nations, relatively minor actors in terms of volume of trade, might seem misplaced. Yet it is entirely emblematic of the emergent field of international economic law and GATT reform in the 1970s. The world economic imaginary of the developing world—represented by the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD) and the G-77—was the Other against which GATT reform was defined. The reason was not (or, in some cases, not only) a crude neocolonialism or cultural supremacism but a backlash against concessions that the Global South had won in the 1960s. Through persuasive knowledge production, effective diplomacy, and collective mobilization, the Global South nations had secured first the so-called Part IV (1966) and then the Generalized System of Preferences (1971) that effectively freed them from GATT disciplines. This was the core of what became known as “special and differential treatment” for developing countries in the world trade regime.

zh: 这些成果相当有限。农业被排除在关贸总协定之外，意味着许多全球南方国家的主要出口仍不得不同美国与欧洲的补贴和保护主义竞争。然而，关贸总协定改革的主张者们认为，对混合发展诉求作出的让步，才是以规则为基础的全球经济衰败进程中无可辩解的核心。石油危机解决之后，海量的石油美元经由华尔街与伦敦金融城回流贷给全球南方的借贷者，全球条件的统一性因此愈发显得迫切。贸易政策研究中心及其内部刊物《世界经济》（The World Economy）成为1970年代和1980年代初批判国际经济新秩序、呼吁改革关贸总协定的集散地。
彼时最尖锐的批评者之一，竟是当今最有影响力的经济评论家之一、英国《金融时报》（Financial Times）的马丁·沃尔夫（Martin Wolf）。沃尔夫1971年从世界银行开始职业生涯（在那里他与日后出任朝圣山学社主席的迪帕克·拉尔〔Deepak Lal〕合著了该行第一份《世界发展报告》），1981年起出任贸易政策研究中心研究主任六年，随后才进入《金融时报》。
在贸易政策研究中心，沃尔夫批评了他所称的“发展中国家的愿望：创造一个由一组国家承担大部分义务、另一组国家享有大部分权利的世界”。
沃尔夫等人认为，发展中国家选择退出关贸总协定纪律，就是在破坏法治。正如沃尔夫参与撰写的1984年贸易政策研究中心报告所言：“发展中国家一直在对国际贸易体系的自由原则发动一场持续的进攻。”
针对特殊与差别待遇，国际经济新秩序反对者的目标是在世界经济中推行“一套规则适用于所有国家”的观念。
en: The victories were tepid ones. The exclusion of agriculture from GATT meant that the primary exports of many Global South countries still had to compete against U.S. and European subsidies and protectionism. Yet the advocates of GATT reform saw concessions to the demands for mixed development as the indefensible core of decay in the rules-based global economy. After the resolution of the oil crisis led to a vast new sea of petrodollars to be recycled through Wall Street and the City of London to lenders in the Global South, the uniformity of conditions globally became all the more pressing. The TPRC and its in-house journal,
became a clearinghouse for critiques of the NIEO and calls to reform the GATT in the 1970s and early 1980s.
One of the sharpest critics at the time was one of today’s most influential economic commentators, Martin Wolf of the

After beginning his career at the World Bank in 1971 (where he coauthored its first World Development Report with future MPS president Deepak Lal), Wolf was the director of studies at the TPRC in 1981 for six years before beginning at the
At the TPRC, Wolf criticized what he called “the desire of developing countries to create a world in which one group of countries has most of the obligations and another most of the rights.”

By opting out of GATT disciplines, Wolf and others argued, developing countries were undermining the rule of law. As a 1984 TPRC report that Wolf helped write put it, “Developing countries have been engaged in a sustained assault on the liberal principles of the international trading system.”
Against special and differential treatment, the goal of NIEO opponents was to promote the idea of one rule for all in the world economy.

zh: 日内瓦最重要的三位关贸总协定改革者都是哈耶克思想的信徒。第一位是扬·图姆利尔，1967年至1985年出任研究处处长，有人忆起时称他是关贸总协定的“常驻哲学家”。
图姆利尔1926年出生于捷克斯洛伐克，先在布拉格学法律，1949年出境移民。在西德待了两年后，他移居美国，1964年获耶鲁大学经济学博士学位。同年他到关贸总协定就任研究职位，并从1968年起在日内瓦高等国际问题研究院任教，直至因心脏病发作英年早逝，终年五十九岁。
日内瓦高等国际问题研究院的图书馆就设在威廉·拉帕德中心内，图姆利尔数百卷的私人藏书至今仍以“扬·图姆利尔遗产文库”（Jan Tumlir Legacy Collection）之名保存在这座如今属于世界贸易组织的建筑里。
en: The three most important GATT reformers in Geneva were all devotees of Hayekian thought. First was Jan Tumlir, the head of the research division from 1967 to 1985, remembered by some as the “resident philosopher” of GATT.

Tumlir was born in Czechoslovakia in 1926 and studied law in Prague before emigrating in 1949. After two years in West Germany, he moved to the United States, where he earned a PhD in economics from Yale in 1964. He moved to the research position at GATT that year, and was also a faculty member at the Graduate Institute of International Studies from 1968 until his premature death by heart attack at the age of fifty-nine.

The library of the Graduate Institute was housed in the Centre William Rappard, and Tumlir’s library of several hundred volumes is still housed as the “Jan Tumlir Legacy Collection” in the building that is now the home of the WTO.

zh: 1970年代，两位律师加入图姆利尔在关贸总协定的行列，日后他们将助他共同阐发其哈耶克式国际秩序理论。弗里德·勒斯勒尔（Frieder Roessler），1939年生，弗莱堡大学毕业生，曾在那里师从哈耶克，1973年三十多岁时来到关贸总协定。
恩斯特-乌尔里希·彼得斯曼（Ernst-Ulrich Petersmann），1945年生，同样在弗莱堡师从哈耶克。1981年加入关贸总协定之前，他曾在海德堡马克斯·普朗克外国公法与国际法研究所担任研究助理，并在德国经济部外贸司的法律办公室工作了三年。在他的教授资格论文中，他特别指出图姆利尔和哈耶克对其思想有着非凡的影响。
到1990年代末，彼得斯曼已成为国际经济法这一领域在国际上最引人注目的实践者与倡导者之一。
en: In the 1970s Tumlir was joined at GATT by two lawyers with whom he would help formulate his Hayekian theory of international order. Frieder Roessler, born in 1939, was a graduate of Freiburg University, where he had studied with Hayek. He arrived at GATT in his early thirties in 1973.

Ernst-Ulrich Petersmann, born in 1945, also studied with Hayek at Freiburg. Before joining GATT in 1981, he had worked as an assistant at the Max Planck Institute for International and Comparative Public Law in Heidelberg and for three years in the legal office of the Foreign Trade Department of the German Economics Ministry. In his habilitation thesis he singled out Tumlir and Hayek for their exceptional influence on his thinking.
By the late 1990s Petersmann became one of the most internationally visible practitioners and advocates of the field of international economic law.

zh: 勒斯勒尔、彼得斯曼与奥克·林登（Åke Linden）是1983年设立的关贸总协定法律事务办公室的首批成员。勒斯勒尔1989年出任关贸总协定法律事务司首任司长，“起草了关于从关贸总协定向世界贸易组织过渡的一整套历史性决定的大部分文本”。
有位学者称图姆利尔与彼得斯曼（连同约翰·H.·杰克逊）为“关贸总协定主要的知识架构师”。

关贸总协定的律师们堪称日内瓦学派新自由主义的当之无愧的传人。他们所有人都曾在日内瓦高等国际问题研究院任教或从事研究。同一拨人中还有杰拉德·柯曾（Gerard Curzon）——《世界贸易法杂志》（Journal of World Trade Law）主编，1966年勒普克（Röpke）逝世后承继了勒普克在日内瓦高等国际问题研究院的讲席——以及他的伴侣维多利亚·柯曾-普赖斯（Victoria Curzon-Price），她在日内瓦大学任教，后来成为朝圣山学社第一位（迄今也是唯一一位）女性主席。日内瓦这一派在关贸总协定改革运动中同贸易政策研究中心密切协作。该中心于1977年创办刊物《世界经济》，首期头条文章即图姆利尔的《国际经济秩序还能挽救吗？》（“Can the International Economic Order Be Saved?”）。
图姆利尔1975年就这篇文章的草稿同哈耶克进行了首次私人联系。他解释说，《世界经济》“面向的是决策者与政治公众，而不是经济学家”，而他这篇文章的“主要思想动力”源自哈耶克的著作。
en: Roessler and Petersmann, along with Ake Linden, were the first members of the GATT’s Office of Legal Affairs, created in 1983. Roessler became the first director of the Division of Legal Affairs at the GATT in 1989 and “drafted the bulk of a series of historical decisions on the transition from the GATT to the WTO.”
One scholar calls Tumlir and Petersmann (along with John H. Jackson) “the GATT’s major intellectual architects.”

The GATT lawyers were worthy heirs to the Geneva School of neoliberalism. All of them either taught or researched at the Graduate Institute of International Studies. Their cohort also included Gerard Curzon, the editor of the

who assumed Röpke’s chair at the Graduate Institute after Röpke’s death in 1966; and his partner, Victoria Curzon-Price, who taught at the University of Geneva and would later become the first (and, thus far, only) female president of the MPS. The Geneva faction worked closely in the campaign for GATT reform with the TPRC, which launched its journal,
in 1977 with a lead article by Tumlir titled “Can the International Economic Order Be Saved?”
Tumlir contacted Hayek personally for the first time in 1975 to send him a draft of the article. He explained that
was intended “to be addressed to policy-makers and political public rather than to economists” and that the “main intellectual impulse” of his article derived from Hayek’s work.

zh: 日内瓦学派的新自由主义者在1970至1980年代试图通过为世界经济创建一套基于规则的体系来挽救国际经济秩序。他们希望扭转关贸总协定内部务实妥协的风气，恢复那种自《罗马条约》给予殖民地国家及其后的后殖民地国家以优惠待遇以来便不断遭受侵蚀的自由秩序的融贯性。
对自由原则的这种“欧非式”（Eurafrican）偏离延续了下来，1960年代又体现为对来自发展中国家的产品给予优惠待遇。继英国1973年加入欧洲经济共同体之后，1975年的《洛美公约》（Lomé Convention）又把联系扩展至46个非洲、加勒比和太平洋国家，取代了先前的《雅温得协定》以及与之对应的英国版安排即《阿鲁沙协定》。
en: Geneva School neoliberals sought to save the international economic order in the 1970s and 1980s by creating a rules-based system for the world economy. They hoped to counteract the atmosphere of pragmatism and compromise that reigned at the GATT and restore the coherence of a liberal order that had been eroding continually since the granting of preferences to colonial and later postcolonial states in the Treaty of Rome.

The “Eurafrican” deviations from liberal principles had continued with the granting of preferences to products from the developing world through the 1960s. Following Britain’s accession to the EEC in 1973, the Lomé Convention of 1975 extended affiliation to forty-six African, Caribbean, and Pacific states, replacing the previous Yaoundé conventions as well as its British counterpart, the Arusha Agreement.

zh: 1973年，勒斯勒尔作为弗莱堡培养出来的律师初到关贸总协定时，听人说这里的人“不相信法律。他们相信实用主义”。
他在1978年解释说，自己的目标是将“哈耶克在更广阔的语境中提出的那些论证”应用于世界经济关系。
问题在于：当世界经济秩序正因“分配公正问题”而受到扰动时，如何校准规则体系，使价格信号得以正确运作？

正如我们所见，哈耶克既提供了演化形成的规则——勒斯勒尔所谓“事实上的规范”（de facto norms）——也提供了有意设计的法律，即勒斯勒尔所谓“法律上的规范”（de iure norms）。勒斯勒尔在承认演化形成的规范总体上更优越的同时，也呼应了哈耶克的论点：当秩序受到威胁时，可以有针对性地重新确立诸原则。他主张必须“把决策转移到能够作长远考虑的司法或准司法机构”，并提示关贸总协定就是这样一个机构，它能够“依据概括性的原则实施或解释规则”。
关贸总协定本身就能够构成我所说的有意设计所能及的那一小块领域。
en: When Roessler arrived as a Freiburg-trained lawyer in 1973, he was told that people at the GATT “do not believe in law. They believe in pragmatism.”
He explained in 1978 that his goal would be to apply “arguments to world economic relations that have been made by Hayek in a broader context.”
The question was how to calibrate the system of rules to allow price signals to operate correctly when world economic order was being disturbed by “issues of distributional equity.”

As we have seen, Hayek offered both “grown” rules, what Roessler called “de facto norms,” as well as laws of deliberate design, or what Roessler called “de iure norms.” While granting the general superiority of grown norms, Roessler echoed Hayek’s argument for the purposive reestablishment of principles when order was under threat. He argued for the necessity of a “transfer of decision-making to judicial or quasi-judicial bodies able to take a long-term view,” suggesting that GATT as one such body that could “administer or interpret the rules in the light of broadly stated principles.”
The GATT itself could constitute what I have called the thin line of deliberate design.

zh: 勒斯勒尔把全球南方视为使世界贸易体系得到更理性组织的主要障碍。由关贸总协定缔约成员组成的联盟，即便只占世界贸易微乎其微的份额，却利用它们的投票来阻止或拖延对《宪章》的修改；用他的话说，发展中国家握有“合法性的钥匙”。
全球南方国家也在主动借用法律的语言来追求自身诉求。它们在关贸总协定框架内争得的优惠待遇，便是“原则化作规则”的一个例子。调门更高的例证则是国际经济新秩序《宣言》本身。尽管联合国的宣言在技术上不具约束力，它们却有一个随时间推移变得更有约束力的倾向：“原则一旦谈判写定，便成为辩论中现成的依据。”
法律上的规范（de iure norms）一旦被全球南方夺取，工业化国家便愈发转向事实上的规范（de facto norms），干脆回避国际组织这一论战场合。由后殖民世界与发展中国家的法律行动主义引发的这类冲突意味着——勒斯勒尔援引杰克逊的一句话来形容——“一套法律结构的全部织物……可能在漫长的岁月中从边缘被一点点啃噬殆尽”。
en: Roessler saw the Global South as the chief obstacle to a more rational organization of the world trading system. Coalitions of contracting members of the GATT with only miniscule portions of world trade were nonetheless using their votes to block or slow changes to the Charter; developing nations, as he put it, held “the key to legality.”

Global South nations were also using the language of law proactively to pursue their own demands. The preferences they secured with GATT were one example of “principles turned into rules.” Even more strident was the Declaration of the NIEO itself. Although UN declarations were technically nonbinding, they had a tendency to harden over time: “Once the principle is negotiated and written down it serves as a ready reference in debates.”

The takeover of de jure norms by the Global South meant that industrialized nations were turning ever more to de facto norms, avoiding the forum of international organizations altogether. Such clashes, caused by the legal activism of the postcolonial and developing world, meant that, as Roessler put it in a quote from John H. Jackson, “the entire fabric of a legal structure can be … chewed away at the fringes over a long period of time.”

zh: 彼得斯曼1970年代的工作，比起勒斯勒尔来更突出地表现为对全球南方各国似乎正在僭取国际法这一局面的回应。在这十年间，彼得斯曼就国际经济新秩序的法律层面撰写了十几篇文章。他论及“非殖民化进程中涌现出80多个欠发达的新兴国家，[以及]100多个发展中国家在联合国大会中占据优势”所造成的“新国家多数”。
用他自己的话说，“新自由主义的国际经济法”正在被再分配与团结的原则所取代，把福利国家以及“经济和社会人权”放大到全球层面。“发展中国家像工会那样组织起来，”他写道，“要求对传统国际经济法来一场全盘革命性的修改。”
国际经济新秩序是一种尝试，图谋“以联合国的计划官僚机构（由欠发达国家的官僚供职）取代分散化的市场经济机制”，而经济合作与发展组织（经合组织，OECD）的成员国“予以拒绝是正确的”。
简言之，贸发会议正在“把民族国家层面的福利国家理念变成一个‘国际化的’福利世界”。
en: Petersmann’s work in the 1970s was defined even more than Roessler’s by a response to the apparent usurpation of international law by the nations of the Global South. Petersmann wrote more than a dozen articles on the legal aspects of the NIEO in that decade. He wrote about the “new state majority” created by the “emergence of over 80 underdeveloped new states in the course of decolonization, [and] the dominance in the General Assembly of the UN of the over 100 developing countries.”

“Neoliberal international economic law,” as he put it, was being replaced by principles of redistribution and solidarity, scaling up the welfare state and “economic and social human rights” to the global level. “The developing countries organized like trade unions,” he wrote, were “demanding a total revolutionary revision of traditional international economic law.”

The NIEO was an attempt at “the replacement of decentralized market economy mechanisms by UN planning bureaucracies (manned by bureaucrats from less developed countries),” which had been “rightly rejected” by the member countries of the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development.
In short, UNCTAD was turning the “national idea of the welfare state into an ‘internationalized’ welfare world.”

zh: 按照彼得斯曼的解读，“欠发达国家与实行国营贸易的国家阻碍了关于世界经济的统一体系构想，也阻碍了一个普遍获得承认的国际经济法体系”。
国际经济新秩序的各项诉求不过是“一堆针对南北关系的个别经济—政治要求，却没有一个总体的政治秩序构想”。
用来攻击自由原则的手段，也正是自1945年以来一直令人忌惮的那一个：联合国的一国一票模式。彼得斯曼提到一场正在推动发展法过关的“对其他联合国机构的选举式接管”。
与勒斯勒尔一样，彼得斯曼承认贸发会议的决议并不具约束力，但他也指出，这些决议假以时日便可能取得法律效力：“由如今已逾100个的发展中国家以多数表决通过的决议，可能严重左右国际法的发展。”
世界场景从1945年“西方各国的小俱乐部”变为“数量大得多、代表着不同文明的诸国集合”，这使国际法本身的性质承受压力。
尤其是对“殖民罪行的赔偿”的要求，“无异于给工业化国家课以一项国际税务义务”。
en: According to Petersmann’s reading, “less developed and state-trading countries prevent a uniform systematic concept for the world economy and a universally recognized international economic law system.”
The demands of the NIEO were “a cornucopia of individual economic-political demands for North–South relations without an overall concept of political order.”

The means of carrying out the assault on liberal principles was the same as had been feared since 1945: the one-country-one-vote model of the UN. Petersmann referred to an “electoral take-over of other UN institutions” that was pushing the law of development through.

Like Roessler, Petersmann acknowledged that UNCTAD’s resolutions were not binding, but he also pointed out that they could take on the force of law with time: “The majority resolutions of now more than 100 developing countries could seriously influence the development of international law.”

The transformation of the world scene from a “small club of western nations” in 1945 to “a much larger number of nations representing different civilizations” had put pressure on the character of international law itself.
Demands for “reparations for colonial guilt,” in particular, were “tantamount to an international tax obligation for industrial countries.”
