zh: 问题在于，“普遍的国际习惯法在多大程度上能够……通过变动中的多数——甚至违背个别国家的意志——被重新创造出来”。
彼得斯曼指出，《各国经济权利和义务宪章》已经被用作利比亚将美国石油特许权益国有化时的法律论据。
与1950年代的新自由主义者一样，外资财产的国有化是他最关心的问题。在彼得斯曼所谓“国内经济非殖民化”的行为中，攫取外国所有财产是错把政治主权当成了经济主权。
非殖民化本身也是一个恰当的先例：“民族自决权”正是“顶着殖民国家的抵抗”才成为现实的。
如果摆脱帝国统治能够被确认为一项权利，那么现有规范的全部装置为何不能被废弃？“1945年以来获得独立的80多个发展中国家，难道即使违背其意志也仍受既有一般国际经济法的约束吗？”
在1970年代，答案似乎明确是否定的。世界正在被重新创造，国际习惯法也随之一起被重新创造。
en: The question was “how far universal international customary law can be … created anew through changing majorities even against the will of individual states.”
Petersmann pointed out that the Charter of the Economic Rights and Duties of States had already been used as a legal argument in the nationalization of American oil concessions by Libya.

As it had also been for neoliberals in the 1950s, the nationalization of foreign owned property was of primary concern. As acts of what Petersmann called “domestic economic decolonization,” seizing foreign-owned property misrecognized political for economic sovereignty.
Decolonization itself was also a case in point, where the “right to self-determination” had become a reality “against the resistance of colonial powers.”

If the right to escape empire could become a right, then why could the entire apparatus of existing norms not be discarded? “[Are] the over eighty developing nations, which have become independent since 1945, bound to the preexisting general international economic law, even against their will”?
In the 1970s the answer seemed like a clear no. The world was being created anew and international customary law along with it.

zh: 关贸总协定的律师们认为有必要着手阻止这些事态发展。彼得斯曼摘取哈耶克的一句话作为一篇论文的题词：“法律思想的本质在于……法律人努力使整个体系融贯一致。”
彼得斯曼把自己的方法论描述为“以秩序思考”（thinking in orders），其来源即他所标举的欧肯、伯姆、勒普克与哈耶克的“新自由主义秩序学派”（
school）。
他援引控制论（cybernetics）方面的研究成果指出，“系统分析”阐明了对规则机制的例外“往往只有放在系统的整体结构中才能理解”，而且“可能在系统的其他部分引发非意愿的副作用”。
换言之，看似无关紧要的偏离会损害“系统内的反应能力”，其效应波及世界经济本身。
en: The GATT lawyers saw it as necessary to work against these developments. Petersmann used a quote from Hayek as an epigraph to an article: “It is the essence of legal thinking … that the lawyer strives to make the whole system consistent.”
Petersmann described his own methodology as that of “thinking in orders,” derived from what he labeled the “neoliberal
school” of Eucken, Böhm, Röpke, and Hayek.

Citing work on cybernetics, he pointed out that “systems analysis” illuminated how exceptions to the “rule mechanisms can often only be understood within the total structure of the system” and “can have undesired side effects in other parts of the system.”
Seemingly inconsequential deviations, in other words, compromised the “capacities of reaction in the system” with effects on the world economy itself.

zh: 在受控制论影响的彼得斯曼的理解中，这个复杂系统必须在可能滋生缺陷的边缘加以巡察管控。发展中国家对关贸总协定规则的违反恰恰就是这种偏离。他谈到“世界经济法”中“多元主义”的危险——对北方一套规则、对南方另一套规则。
1977年，由图姆利尔参与合著的一篇文章中，关贸总协定研究处表达了类似的论调：“一旦认识到任何一次成功的违规都会树立先例——无论在国内还是国外……此类先例的累积便可能瓦解整个精密分工却又彼此协调的活动秩序。”
对这些思想者而言，1970年代世界贸易体系完整性的最大威胁，恰恰来自其中经济力量最弱的行动者的积极造法，而这些行动者大多刚刚从帝国历史中走出、成为主权国家。全球南方的行动者不去遵从前一个时代的自由主义准则，反而提议为游戏另立新规则，这就有可能使整个体系瘫痪。
en: In Petersmann’s understanding, influenced by cybernetics, the complex system had to be policed at the margins where flaws could originate. The violations of GATT rules by developing countries constituted just such deviations. He wrote of the danger of “pluralism” in “world economic law,” with one set of rules for the North and another for the South.

In a 1977 piece coauthored by Tumlir, the GATT Research Division struck a similar note, remarking that “once it is realized that any successful infraction of the rules sets a precedent, both at home and abroad … an accumulation of such precedents may undermine the whole order of intricately specialized yet coordinated activity.”

For these thinkers, the biggest threat to the integrity of the world trading system in the 1970s was the activism of its least powerful economic players, most of which had just emerged as nations from a history of empire. By proposing new rules for the game rather than adhering to the liberal precepts of an earlier era, Global South actors threatened to cripple the entire system.

zh: 这三位哈耶克派关贸总协定专家中最重要的一位，是年长的图姆利尔。他与哈耶克的学生们一样，执着于把国际经济新秩序看作一次全球性的系统错误，称其为世界经济秩序中的一种“退行性发展”（degenerative development）。

他很早就明白，1970年代变了样的情势为何使发展中国家不仅在国际组织占有多数席位，还在经济上获得了新的重要性。1974年，图姆利尔在贸易政策研究中心做了一次演讲，其内容以报纸社论的形式刊出。他解释了石油危机的解决方式——石油收入翻了四倍——如何构成一道难题：这些新增的流动资金将流向何方？他得出的结论是，唯一不引发通胀的结果，就是把石油美元投向渴求资本的全球南方，以刺激其工业化项目。随社论刊发的一幅迈克尔·希思（Michael Heath）所作漫画，画出一个被画得面目怪异的阿拉伯人，把一枚刻着工业标志的硬币抛给一名仰卧的、缠头巾、同样鹰钩鼻的乞丐，乞丐代表着全球南方。图姆利尔主张，工业化国家可以通过为“这场巨量新投资提供装备、机器、工程与管理诀窍”而获利，从而“有机会挣回它们的石油美元，而不必互相残杀”。
en: The most important in the trio of Hayekian GATT experts was the elder figure, Tumlir. He shared the fixation of Hayek’s students on the NIEO as a global system error, describing it as a “degenerative development” in the world economic order.

He realized early why the changed circumstances of the 1970s made the developing countries newly important beyond their growing majority in international organizations. In a 1974 talk at the TPRC that was published as a newspaper editorial, Tumlir explained how the resolution of the oil crisis—through the quadrupling of oil revenues—presented a quandary: Where would all the extra liquidity flow? He concluded that the only noninflationary outcome would be the investment of petrodollars to the capital-hungry Global South as a spur to industrialization projects. A cartoon by Michael Heath accompanying the editorial pictured a grotesquely caricatured Arab man flipping a coin marked with the sign of industry to a supine turbaned and similarly hook-nosed beggar representing the Global South. Industrialized countries, Tumlir argued, would profit by providing “equipment, machinery, engineering and management know-how for this new massive investment” and would thereby “have an opportunity to earn their petrodollars without cutting each other’s throat.”

zh: 这幅用简单图式表现经济关系的种族主义漫画没有画出的，是从中东通往全球南方这条路线上的关键中转站：华尔街与伦敦金融城——金融服务业将在引导投资南下方面扮演关键角色。在图姆利尔的解读中，有一点很清楚：如果全球南方得到一笔巨大的新增投资资本，那么要求它们遵守规则的压力就会愈发沉重，因为规则要为投资者保障可预期性。图姆利尔的这篇社论刊于1974年2月初。不到三个月后，国际经济新秩序宣言便在联合国大会获得通过，这表明七十七国集团无意遵从旧规范，而是另起炉灶、自写规则。
en: Not pictured in the schematic (and racist) cartoon were the critical way-stations on the route from Middle East to Global South: Wall Street and the City of London, where the financial services sector would play a key role in directing investment Southward. It was clear in Tumlir’s reading that if the Global South received a huge new pool of investment capital, the onus would be ever more on them to adhere to rules that would secure predictability for investors. Tumlir’s editorial appeared in early February 1974. Less than three months later the NIEO declaration passed in the UN General Assembly, suggesting that the G-77 had no intention of cooperating with the old norms and sought to write their own rules instead.

zh: 在哈耶克八十寿辰的庆祝场合发表讲话时，图姆利尔抨击了全球南方的破坏性狂妄。他说，国际经济新秩序表达的是“相信现代社会有能力主动进行自我改革和自我调节”。这不是肯定而是否定的东西：“诸国不仅声称要在全世界秩序之内决定自己的未来；如今这个秩序本身也要被超越，整个世界都要动员起来，在宇宙秩序之内决定自身的未来。”

图姆利尔相信，贫穷国家结成的七十七国集团正在犯沃尔特·李普曼（Walter Lippmann）1930年代就已看清、哈耶克此后一贯诊断的那种错误。它们正沦为“全能与全知”的诱惑的猎物——那种误以为人真能改天换地的错误信念。最令图姆利尔恼火的，是“秩序”一词本身被人挪用。他指出，这个词有两重含义：“一是可观察结果的秩序（街道安宁、物价稳定）”；但“在更具分析性的意义上，这一概念用来指产生那种可观察的规律性与秩序的那一整套规则与制度”。
秩序的目标不是给予人民想要的东西，而是阻止他们拿去自己想要的东西——否则便会摧毁整个体系。他那句不容置疑的断语足以充当整个日内瓦学派新自由主义的口号：“国际规则保护世界市场免受政府侵害。”
世界经济必须防御政府本身的干预，而政府自身也需要受到保护，以免被那些只受私利驱动、不负责任的民众牵着走。
en: Speaking on the occasion of Hayek’s eightieth birthday, Tumlir attacked the destructive hubris of the Global South. The NIEO, he said, expressed “the confidence in modern societies’ power of deliberate self-reform and self-regulation.” This was not positive but negative: “Not only do nations claim to be determining their own future within a global order; now that order itself is to be transcended, the world as such [is] being mobilized to determine its own future within the order of the universe.”

Tumlir believed that the G-77 coalition of poor nations was making the same mistake that Walter Lippman had seen in the 1930s and Hayek had diagnosed ever since. They were falling prey to the allure of “omnipotence and omniscience”—the misguided belief that one could actually change the world. Most galling for Tumlir was the appropriation of the term “order” itself. As he noted, the word has two meanings: “There is the order of observed results (the streets are safe and prices stable),” but “in a more analytical sense, the concept is used to denote the set of rules and institutions which produce the observed regularity and orderliness.”

The goal of order was not to give the people what they want but to prevent them from taking what they want—and thereby destroying the system as a whole. His apodictic phrase could serve as a slogan for the entire Geneva School of neoliberalism: “International rules protect the world market against governments.”
The world economy must be defended against governments themselves, which themselves need to be protected from their feckless populations driven only by self-interest.

zh: 图姆利尔主张，各国遵循这些规则，也是在抵御内部攫取性力量的过程中挽救自身的主权。他1981年说：“国际经济秩序[能够]充当一种额外的巩固手段，保护国家主权免受内部侵蚀。”
也是在这一年，他引述梅斯特马克（Mestmäcker）的话：“问题在于如何给经济构序、使之定型，令其既不能成为国家的仆役，也不能成为国家的主宰。”
通过采纳具有约束力的规则，各国在捍卫世界经济的同时也拯救了自己。至于这样的主权意味着的不是无限制的自主，而是服从世界市场力量的支配——这一点被视作理所当然。在对国际经济新秩序核心范畴的一次关键重构中，图姆利尔提出：秩序既不是稳定，也不是公正；毋宁说，“秩序即调适”。
正如哈耶克笔下随风向变化的那片树叶的隐喻，要繁盛——也要生存——就得向持续的变化保持开放。他作为关贸总协定研究团队负责人参与合著的一篇文章如此表述：“对变化的调适是经济增长的必要条件——实际上，增长过程无非是一连串的调适。”
简言之，国际经济新秩序所说的“秩序”无非是“一种拒绝调适”。
合起来看，关贸总协定的改革者们认为，七十七国集团关于再分配和特殊与差别待遇的要求，会在统一的规则体系中造成畸变，进而可能导致世界经济机制的灾难性失灵。秩序意味着体系之内的持续适应，而立法者与制度的角色，就是把体系的规则转变为有约束力的立法。所需要的不仅是一位经济宪法的守护者，更是一个稳态（homeostatic）系统的守护者。
en: Tumlir contended that by following these rules, states would be also salvaging their own sovereignty against internally grasping forces. He said in 1981: “The international economic order [could act] as an additional means of entrenchment protecting national sovereignty against internal erosion.”
Also in that year he quoted Mestmäcker: “The problem is how to structure, or order, an economy so that it can become neither the servant, nor the master of the state.”

By adopting binding rules, states would save themselves as they defended the world economy. The fact that such sovereignty would mean not unbounded autonomy but a subjection to the forces of the world market was taken as a matter of course. In a key reframing of the central category of the NIEO, Tumlir contended that order was not stability nor was it equity: instead, “order is adjustment.”

Like Hayek’s metaphorical leaf adapting to the changing wind, to thrive—and survive—was to be open to constant change. A piece he coauthored as the head of the GATT research team expressed it this way: “Adjustment to change is a necessary condition of economic growth—indeed, the growth process is little more than a sequence of adjustments.”
The “order” of the NIEO, in short, was nothing more than “a refusal to adjust.”

Taken together, the GATT reformers saw the G-77 demands for redistribution and special and differential treatment as producing aberrations in the uniform system of rules, which could lead to a catastrophic breakdown of the mechanism of the world economy. Order meant continual adaptation within a system, and the role of lawmakers and institutions was to transform the system’s rules into binding legislation. What was needed was not only a guardian for the economic constitution but a guardian of the homeostatic system.

zh: 校准分层秩序
1980年代初，图姆利尔反思20世纪世界经济秩序的难题。呼应在他之前的勒普克与哈耶克，他写道，1914年以前，“秩序在未被充分理解的情况下运转着”。尽管这种非正式的自发状态是最好的可能秩序，它却无法轻易复制。这一点已为事实所明证：“那些在1914年之前执掌国际经济秩序的同批人，1918年之后却无力将其重建。”
图姆利尔指出，罗宾斯与哈耶克在1930年代提出了他们的联邦方案，作为第一种解决之道。与其他战间期自由主义者（包括秩序自由主义者伯姆与欧肯）一样，他们察觉到“民族主义有一种内在倾向，会把民主国家的经济政策颠覆为零和博弈”。
图姆利尔采纳了他们的洞见：在民主条件下，大众俘获了国家。自此以后，国家“不再是政府，而沦为有组织利益集团角斗的竞技场”。
图姆利尔援引当代公共选择理论家使用过的一个说法写道：“市场失灵固然偶尔可见，政府失灵（
）却无处不在、影响广泛而严重。”
en: At the beginning of the 1980s Tumlir reflected on the problem of world economic order in the twentieth century. Echoing Röpke and Hayek before him, he wrote that before 1914, “order functioned without being fully understood.” Although this informal spontaneity was the best possible order, it could not be reproduced easily. This was made clear when “the same men who administered the international economic order before 1914 were unable to reconstitute it after 1918.”

Tumlir observed that Robbins and Hayek had proposed their federal plans as a first solution in the 1930s. Along with other interwar liberals, including the ordoliberals Böhm and Eucken, they perceived that there was an “inherent tendency of nationalism to subvert economic policy of democratic states into a zero-sum game.”

Tumlir adopted their insight that the masses capture the state under conditions of democracy. After this point, the state “ceases to be a government and becomes an arena for gladiatorial combats of organized interests.”
“Where market failures are occasionally discernible,” Tumlir noted, using a phrase employed by contemporary public choice theorists, “
is pervasive and massive.”

zh: 图姆利尔的结论——他与彼得斯曼和勒斯勒尔共享这一结论——呼应了斯蒂格勒（Stigler）在香港提出的观点。他自问社会主义者为何在节节胜利，并承认也许民主按其自身逻辑恰恰就会导向社会主义。“经济秩序的运转取决于其一般规则的内在融贯，而民主政治过程却在很大程度上着力于为特定群体确保例外。”
因此，要抵御社会主义、抵御国家在碎片化中沦为个别利益集团的“猎物”，要保卫资本的安全与流动，就必须有一种制度性的解决方案。图姆利尔回顾道，罗宾斯与哈耶克针对所谓政府失灵——他所指的是国家无力保护世界经济——提出的解方，是设立一个“国际权威……被赋予实际权力去制定规则、依规则裁判并强制执行裁决”。
然而，他们的缺陷在于：缺乏适当手段，在联邦内仍保有形式主权的各国执行这些规则。
en: Tumlir’s conclusion, which he shared with Petersmann and Roessler, echoed that of Stigler in Hong Kong. Asking why the socialists were winning, he conceded that perhaps democracy may simply lead by its own logic to socialism. “While the working of the economic order depends on the internal consistency of its general rules, the democratic political process is largely concerned with securing exceptions for particular groups.”

Thus, to fend off socialism or the state’s becoming, in its fragmentation, the “prey” of individual interest groups, and to defend the safety and mobility of capital, required an institutional fix. Tumlir recalled that the solution of Robbins and Hayek to this so-called government failure—by which he meant a failure of the state to protect the world economy—was in an “international authority … endowed with effective power to make rules, adjudicate under them and enforce the decisions.”
Their error, however, was the absence of adequate means to enforce those rules within the nations in the federation that remained formally sovereign.

zh: 1930年代的新自由主义联邦主义者曾对开明国家的良好意愿抱有乐观，认为它们能够在看清自身利益的前提下恪守全球规则。图姆利尔把1945年之后的安排看作与这种构想的类似物：各国接受了规则，遵循布雷顿森林体系的指针，并在很大程度上遵守关贸总协定的规则。在某些方面，他认为这印证了哈耶克与罗宾斯对开明联邦主义的期望。这种暂时的“世界经济的重新整合，是一种约束各国经济政策的新纪律的产物。各国政府通过接受共同商定的国际规则，接受了这种纪律。”
这一模式自此难以为继的关键转折点，是欧洲海外帝国的终结。他写道，问题出现于“非殖民化使独立国家的数目大增之时。它们开始对战后国际秩序的种种纪律提出各种各样的豁免要求”。
当工业化国家准予这些例外时，它们便默认了这样一种看法：“纪律……是只有富国才享用得起的奢侈品，事实上甚至是经济增长的障碍。”
对前殖民地的优惠待遇、关贸总协定的第四部分、非互惠原则——凡此种种，都是北方所作让步的体现，等于承认通往现代化的王道就是保护幼稚产业、施惠性的资源转移，以及打破规则的权利。
en: The 1930s neoliberal federalists had been optimistic about the good faith of enlightened nations capable of discerning their own self-interest in sticking to the global rules. Tumlir saw the post-1945 settlement as similar to this arrangement. Nations agreed to the rules, following the guidelines of the Bretton Woods system and largely adhering to the rules of the GATT. In some ways he saw this as a vindication of Hayek and Robbins’s hope for enlightened federalism. This temporary “reintegration of the world economy was thus a result of the new discipline governing the conduct of national economic policies. This discipline was accepted by governments in the form of agreed international rules.”

The critical turning point after which this model was no longer viable was the end of European overseas empire. Problems emerged, he noted, “when decolonization greatly increased the number of independent countries. They came to claim all kinds of dispensations from the disciplines” of the postwar international order.

When the industrial nations granted these exceptions, they implicitly acquiesced to the view that “discipline … was a luxury only the rich could afford; that it was, in fact, an obstacle to economic growth.”

The preferential treatment of former colonial countries, the Part IV of the GATT, and nonreciprocity—these were all aspects of the North’s concession that the royal road to modernization was through infant industry protection, benevolent transfers, and the right to break the rules.

zh: 1977年，在哈伯勒于美国企业研究所（American Enterprise Institute）主持的国际经济新秩序会议上，图姆利尔警告说，当前局势与1930年代有着“可怕的”相似之处。
无论在战间期还是1970年代，错步都在于图姆利尔借用卡尔·波普尔（Karl Popper）的话所命名的“‘主权的谬误’——把主权理解为无限权力、近乎全能的那种观念”。
我们再次看到，新自由主义者呼吁人们从世界秩序出发，作整体性的思考，并意识到复杂的相互依赖关系提出的条件。图姆利尔非但没有搬用个人自由的修辞，反而把他的警世之言置于哈耶克启发下的日内瓦学派式修辞之中：总体性的运转内在地限定了自由，亦即他所谓的“相互依赖的代价”——某些“正当的国家目标……必须为国际秩序的纪律作出牺牲”。
en: At Haberler’s conference on the NIEO at the American Enterprise Institute in 1977, Tumlir warned of “frightening” parallels to the 1930s.
In both the interwar period and the 1970s, the misstep was what Tumlir quoted Karl Popper to dub “ ‘the fallacy of sovereignty,’ the concept of sovereignty as unlimited power, virtual omnipotence.”

Once again we see that the neoliberal intervention was a call to think holistically—in world orders—and to be aware of the conditions of complex interdependence. Far from employing a rhetoric of personal freedom, Tumlir cast his warnings in the Hayek-inspired Geneva School rhetoric of the limits to freedom inherent in the functioning of the totality, or what he called the “costs of interdependence” by which certain “legitimate national objectives … have to be sacrificed to the discipline of the international order.”

zh: 借鉴系统论的观念，关贸总协定的改革者们认为，偏离规则的做法会蔓延，并因相互仿效而延续。正如图姆利尔所说：“一旦构成国际秩序的规则被视作增长的障碍，这套秩序便难以捍卫。而当领导国自身也开始要求豁免于它诱使别国接受的规则时，秩序也就终结了。”
尽管全球贸易额不断增长——人们或可笼统地视之为一体化的征兆——但对法律规范的偏离已使世界秩序处于“严重的解体状态”。
en: Drawing on ideas of system theory, the GATT reformers felt that the drift from rules was contagious and perpetuated by imitation. As Tumlir put it, “Once the rules constituting the international order are seen as an obstacle to growth, the order becomes hard to defend. And it ends when the leading country itself begins to claim exceptions from the rules it has induced others to accept.”

Despite the ever-increasing volume of global trade—which one might see generically as a sign of integration—the deviations from the legal norm had left the world order in “an advanced state of disintegration.”

zh: 图姆利尔经由一次尺度转换抵达了他的解方。他采纳了伯姆1930年代提出的决断主义式“抉择”——择定一部“经济宪法”——的呼吁，并向前迈出德国这位法学家本人未曾迈出的一步：把这一方法移置到国际尺度。
在一篇满怀敬意的文章中，图姆利尔注意到这位德国法学家论及“国际母体”（the international matrix）的文字之稀少，并力陈：“一部经济宪法，若没有一套对外经济政策及其法律控制的理论，便是不完整的。”
他提出沿两个实践方向推进伯姆的思想。其一是发展“一套关于涉外交往中私人权利的理论（及其有约束力的表述）”。这与本叙事早前关于把国际私法创建为一个无论哪国管辖都可以得到保障的全球领域的讨论相呼应：国际投资法以及新的商人法（
）的观念都可以归入这一范畴。其二是发展“一套理论，把经济外交所缔结的国际协定与政策规则适当地锚定于国内法之中”。
正是在这里，图姆利尔提出了他将为日内瓦学派新自由主义的制度设计留下的持久贡献：以民族国家的法院与宪法为手段，把资本的权利锁进国内法律体系。
en: Tumlir arrived at his solution through a scale shift. He adopted Böhm’s call from the 1930s for a decisionistic “choice” of an “economic constitution” but took the step, which the German lawyer had not done, of transposing this method to the international scale.

In an admiring essay, Tumlir noted the scarcity of the German jurist’s references to “the international matrix” and insisted that “an economic constitution is not complete without a theory of foreign economic policy and the legal control of it.”

He proposed taking Böhm’s thought in two directions of practical application. The first was to develop “a theory (and binding articulation) of private rights with respect to foreign transactions.” This resonates with this narrative’s earlier discussions regarding the creation of private international law as a global domain defensible regardless of national jurisdiction. International investment law and the idea of a new
can be placed in this realm. The second direction was to develop “a theory of adequate anchoring in domestic law of the international agreements and policy rules established by economic diplomacy.”

Here Tumlir introduced what would be his lasting contribution to the institutional design of Geneva School neoliberalism: using national courts and constitutions as the means by which capital rights are locked into domestic legal systems.

zh: 与所有新自由主义者一样，图姆利尔认识到，市场要发挥其有益的规训，就需要一个超经济的框架。“国际贸易与支付体系本身无法对主权政府施加纪律，即无法迫使它们在行动上遵从体系的规则。”

此处不妨回想勒普克对那种“法律教条主义”（juridicism）的嗤之以鼻——它仿佛以为各国会遵守在国际层面订立、拿到海牙、联合国或其他地方去诉讼裁决的法典。图姆利尔的解法不同，而且更激进——法律不在各国之间运作，而在各国之内运作；不是在边境上，而是在“边境后”（beyond the border），日后的说法即是如此。这个体系最终依靠的不是国际层面的努力，而是“各国主动遵守并由此维护这一体系的努力”。
由于“当前的危机……不是经济危机，而是政治危机”，司法机构便是绕开民选实体干预的一条途径。他写道：“法院是能够使立法决策受国际商定的规则约束的机构。”
执行世界经济法的将不是国际法院，而是国内法院。法院提供了必要的楔子，也提供了对他们自己曾经听任发生的“宪制缺口”的补救。
en: Like all neoliberals, Tumlir recognized that for the market to exert its salutary discipline, it needed an extra-economic framework. “The inter
system of trade and payments as such cannot exercise discipline over sovereign governments in the sense of compelling them to conform in their actions to the system’s rules.”
Recall here Röpke’s scoffing at the “juridicism” that implied that nations would follow codes set at an inter

level and litigated at the Hague, the UN, or elsewhere. Tumlir’s solution was different and more radical—law would not be conducted between nations but within nations, not at the border but “beyond the border,” as it would become known. The system depended ultimately not on an inter
effort but on an “active
effort to conform to it and so uphold it.”

Because “the present crisis [was] not economic … but political,” the judiciary was a means of eluding the interference of democratically elected entities. “The courts are the agency which can bring the inter
ly-agreed rules to bear on legislative decisions,” he wrote.
Domestic courts, not inter
courts, would enforce world economic law. Courts offered the necessary wedge and the solution to the “constitutional breach” they themselves had allowed to occur.

zh: 在试图为重建秩序找到理论依据时，图姆利尔把目光投向一个表面看来颇为古怪的地方：哈耶克关于分层的行为规则的思想。哈耶克曾描述过一个等级体系：人为制定的规则只在最上面构成薄薄一层，其下是传统中演化形成的规则和生理上的本能冲动。图姆利尔把在“国家、区域与国际体系之间”的一系列尺度上设计规则的需要，称为“对哈耶克关于秩序之分层这一洞见的刻意运用”。
他所引用的那篇文章是哈耶克较为冷僻的文字之一，也是最直接讨论控制论问题的一篇。那篇文章的同构主义（isomorphism）色彩一如其常，开篇便说：“构成群体的个体成员是动物还是人，这并不重要……”又在脚注里补上一句：“甚至他们是生命有机体还是某种自我复制的机械构造，也一样。”
en: In looking for a way to theorize a restored order, Tumlir looked in a place that superficially seems curious: Hayek’s idea of stratified rules of conduct. Hayek had described a tiered system with made rules as a thin line of deliberate design resting atop the grown rules of tradition and the physiological impulses of instinct. Tumlir described the need to design rules at a series of scales “between national, regional and international systems” as a “deliberate application of Hayek’s insight concerning the stratification of order.”

The essay he cited was one of Hayek’s more obscure and dealt with cybernetic questions most directly. It was typical in its isomorphism, beginning with the statement “It does not matter … whether the individual members which make up the groups are animals or men” and adding in a footnote “or even whether they are living organisms or perhaps some sort of reduplicating mechanical structures.”

zh: 据图姆利尔自述，上文考察过的那段文本也对他产生了影响——那是《法律、立法与自由》（
）三部曲结尾的一段，哈耶克曾在香港把它作为一篇演讲宣读过。1979年6月，在写下他自己关于国际秩序的最重要的几篇综述性文字之前，图姆利尔致信哈耶克，赞叹“你第三卷精彩绝伦的结尾”，说它改变了他“在许多问题上的看法”。他写道：“很难设想，在本世纪或未来五十年内，竟有人能为正义理论与自由秩序提供更深厚的基础。”
图姆利尔宣称“一国经济、一国宪法框架下的政治以及国际经济秩序，都可以视为自我调节、维持稳态的系统”，以此表明他接受了哈耶克思想中的控制论基调。
在图姆利尔看来，哈耶克对民族国家之上垂直性问题与联邦形式的关注，恰好补充了秩序自由主义者对民族国家内部水平面问题的聚焦。
en: By his own testimony, Tumlir was also influenced by the text explored above, an extract from the end of the

trilogy, which Hayek delivered as a speech in Hong Kong. In June 1979, before he wrote his most important synthetic texts on international order, Tumlir wrote to Hayek about the “marvelous ending of your third volume,” which had changed his “views on a number of issues.” “It is difficult to imagine,” he wrote, “that anyone in this century or the next fifty years could provide a deeper foundation for a theory of justice and liberal order.”

Tumlir signaled his acceptance of the cybernetic undertones in Hayek when he asserted that “an economy, national politics under a constitution and the international economic order can all be considered homeostatic self-equilibrating systems.”
To Tumlir, Hayek’s attention to the problems of verticality and federal forms above the nations complemented the ordoliberal focus on horizontality within the nation.

zh: 对哈耶克理论的改换运用并非图姆利尔一人所为。彼得斯曼也援引哈耶克关于行为规则分层的论述，论证“原则与规则旨在影响个体行为，并促进‘自发秩序’或有意创建的‘指令秩序’，从而使经济主体能够就个体（包括政府官员）在经济领域的未来行为形成相当正确的预期”。
他自己对全球经济的界定强烈地依循控制论隐喻。“数十亿人之间深度展开的国际分工之所以可能，只有靠很大程度上依赖作为控制论反馈机制的自发市场价格所传递的信息（informations，原文如此）以及靠受国内和国际公法与私法的一般框架规则引导的千百万人的自由努力。”
他提出，哈耶克关于法律层级垂直序列的观念，既反映了经济秩序的实际历史形态——尤其是第二次世界大战之后的形态——也反映了一种规范性的、应当追求的秩序。
耐人寻味的是，在1980年代之交——彼时控制论在哈耶克思想中的作用甚至尚未得到学界的承认——哈耶克与关贸总协定的法律专家们竟从关于分层的传播与行动的体系这一共同视点出发写作。在日内瓦这些新自由主义专家的著述中，哈耶克用以说明认知问题的多层次隐喻，被放大到全球尺度上用来重构世界经济秩序。
en: Tumlir was not alone in his repurposing of Hayek’s theories. Petersmann also cited Hayek’s work on stratification of rules of conduct to argue that “principles and rules are designed to influence individual behavior and to promote ‘spontaneous order’ or deliberately created ‘directed orders’ so as to enable economic agents to form reasonably correct expectations regarding the future behavior of individuals (including government officials) in the economic sphere.”

His own definition of the global economy adhered strongly to cybernetic metaphors. “A far-reaching international division of labor among billions of people is possible only by relying, to a large extent, on the informations [

] conveyed by spontaneous market prices (as a cybernetic feedback mechanism) and on the free efforts of millions of people guided by general framework rules of private and public national and international law.”

He proposed Hayek’s idea of a vertical hierarchy of legal layers as reflecting both the actual historical forms of economic order, especially after the Second World War, and a normative, aspirational order.

It is striking that at the turn of the 1980s, before the role of cybernetics in Hayek’s thought had even been acknowledged by scholars, Hayek and the GATT legal experts were writing from a shared perspective on hierarchical systems of communication and conduct. In the work of the neoliberal experts in Geneva, the multitiered metaphor that Hayek used for cognition was scaled up to rethink world economic order.

zh: 然而，这些相当抽象的哈耶克式概念如何付诸操作？国内体系与国际体系之间的反馈机制如何保障？关贸总协定改革者采纳的模板，是第6章所述、由梅斯特马克阐发的欧洲式多层级治理模式与“经济宪法”。
图姆利尔把关贸总协定在为自身规则提供“权威性解释”方面的“软弱”，同欧洲经济共同体创制“统一的欧洲法律”的“激进”解法作了对比。关键在于：“共同的欧洲法律凌驾于成员国的国内法之上。”
他写道，就观念而言，“这是实施超国家秩序的最强形式。其规则是真正的法律，完全融入成员国的国内法，由单一权威机构加以解释，并赋予私人可强制执行的请求权，要求任何成员国履行其条约承诺”。
欧洲法律的特殊之处在于，用法律行话来说，它在民族国家之内具有“直接效力”（directly effective）。这就是说，个人——以及“法人”（legal persons，一个关键性地包括公司在内的范畴）——可以在本国法院援用欧洲法律；“共同的欧洲法律凌驾于成员国国内法之上”这一事实，加上国内法院执行欧洲共同体法律，使之成为解决国家间秩序问题的“最激进”的进路。
对图姆利尔而言，欧洲共同体在其理想形态下所内置的这种能力——保障价格信号经由个人、国家、超国家诸层级顺畅传递——使它成为“哈耶克意义上中间秩序的一个近乎完美的范例”。
en: Yet how could these rather abstract Hayekian concepts be operationalized? How could the feedback mechanism between national and international systems be secured? The template adopted by the GATT reformers was the European model of multilevel governance and the “economic constitution” described in Chapter 6, as articulated by Mestmäcker.

Tumlir contrasted the “weakness” of the GATT in providing an “authoritative interpretation of its rules” to the “radical” solution of the EEC in creating a “uniform European law.” Crucial was that “the common European law overrides the national law of member states.”

Conceptually, he wrote, “this is the strongest possible form of implementing a supranational order. Its rules are genuine law, fully integrated into municipal law of member States, interpreted by a single authority, and creating enforceable private claims on each member State to comply with its treaty commitments.”

What was special about European law was that it was, in the legal jargon, “directly effective” in nation-states. That meant that individual citizens—and “legal persons” (a category that crucially included corporations)—could appeal to European law within their domestic courts; the fact that “the common European law overrides the national law of member states” and that national courts enforced European Community law made it “the most radical” approach to the problem of inter-state order.

For Tumlir, the built-in capacity of the European Community in its ideal form to enforce smoothness of the transmission of price signals across the levels of the individual, the national, and the supranational made it “a nearly perfect example of an intermediate order in the Hayekian sense.”

zh: 对图姆利尔、彼得斯曼以及世界贸易组织起草者那个极具影响力的群体中的其他人来说，目标是将新自由主义宪政的“欧洲理念”从欧洲大陆放大到世界经济，把世贸组织变成一部“贸易宪法”，其中争端解决机构与上诉机构将充当欧洲法院的对应物。
与日内瓦学派新自由主义的发展路径一致，他们的构想结合了伯姆与哈耶克的思想，把新自由主义的决断主义和一位强有力法律执行者的愿景，带入哈耶克式的分层秩序这一控制论构型之中。出于对国际经济新秩序造成世界贸易秩序“退行”及其潜在传染效应的担忧，这些关贸总协定改革者力求实现哈耶克构想的精神——校准一套关于正当行为规则的分层秩序，使价格与法律、权利一道充当“调适的信号与激励”。
en: For Tumlir, Petersmann, and others in the influential cohort of the drafters of the WTO, the goal was to scale up the “European idea” of neoliberal constitutionalism from the continent to the world economy, making the WTO into a “trade constitution” in which the Dispute Settlement Body and the Appellate Body would act as equivalents of the European Court of Justice.

Consistent with the development of Geneva School neoliberalism, their idea joined the thinking of Böhm and Hayek, bringing neoliberal decisionism and a vision of the strong legal enforcer to the Hayekian cybernetic construct of stratified, multilevel order. Inspired by their concern about the “degeneration” of the world trade order effected by the NIEO and its potentially contagious effects, the GATT reformers sought to fulfill the spirit of Hayek’s vision by calibrating a stratified order for rules of just conduct in which prices as well as laws and rights would act as “signals and incentives for adjustment.”

zh: 图姆利尔1985年因心脏病猝然离世，没能亲眼看到他的部分构想开花结果；但他的思想上的同道彼得斯曼，却在他参与创建的国际经济法这一学科中，成为推动世界经济“宪法化”理念的领军人物之一，精准地推进着图姆利尔在1980年代之交识别出的那些议题。
1990年代中期诞生的世贸组织并不完全如改革者所设想的那样。不过，通过允许某些权利具有直接效力（在知识产权领域便是如此），并通过把执行对象从关贸总协定“边境上”的议题转向包括服务、知识产权以及劳工、环境和卫生标准在内的“边境之后”的议题，世贸组织确实实现了垂直分层秩序的部分规范性期许。
本书这些篇章所讲述的故事，不能替代对导致1995年世贸组织成立的那场谈判与讨价还价混战的还原。通往世贸组织的道路是一条由外交、政治经济与强权政治交织而成的曲折之路，其中美国作为最重要的玩家高居其上。

然而，在把世贸组织描述为美国强权政治的工具、或是发展中国家在无权无势状态下进行谈判的空间时，人们往往感受不到支撑这项事业本身的那些驱动性理念。我们从关贸总协定中哈耶克主义者们的著述里打捞起的，是一条把1920年代至1990年代新自由主义世界经济想象连接起来的思想系谱。就本书的叙事而言，它是20世纪新自由主义寻求制度解决方案历程的最后一幕——在他们眼中，这个世界始终受到民主的阵阵痉挛以及那种毁灭性信念的威胁，即以为全球规则可以被重铸以向社会正义倾斜。如果说“一个世界”的观念在第二次世界大战结束时曾有过一刻高光，那么它在1970年代曾拥有整整十年。世界经济的各种愿景与模型在专家圈层和公共文化中喷涌而出。1968年首次问世的从外层空间拍摄整个地球的“蓝色弹珠”照片，成为1970年第一个地球日的象征，并最终成为有史以来被复制最多的图像之一。
1965年，美国驻联合国大使阿德莱·史蒂文森（Adlai Stevenson）在日内瓦发表演说，锻造了一个将在随后十年不断回响的隐喻。他把地球的居民设想为“一艘小小宇宙飞船上的乘客，依赖着船上易于耗竭的空气与土壤储备；我们全部人的安危都系于飞船的安全与和平；使我们免于毁灭的，唯有我们对这艘脆弱飞船倾注的照料、辛劳——我还要说——爱”。
“外层空间那可怕的恢宏”使地球失去了中心位置，引人注意人类生存的飘摇无依，以及为确保物种存续所需要的全球合作。
en: Although Tumlir died suddenly of a heart attack in 1985 and was not alive to see some of his ideas bear fruit, his intellectual partner Petersmann was one of the leading figures promoting the idea of “constitutionalizing” the world economy in the discipline of international economic law that he had helped create, pushing precisely the issues that Tumlir identified at the turn of the 1980s.

The WTO that came into being in the mid-1990s was not exactly as the reformers envisioned. Nonetheless, by allowing some directly effective rights (in the case of intellectual property) and moving from enforcing the “at-the-border” issues of GATT to “beyond-the-border” issues including services, intellectual property rights, and labor, environmental, and health standards, it did fulfill some of the normative desiderata of the vertical stratified order.

The story told in these pages cannot substitute for reconstructing the scrum of negotiation and bargaining that led to the creation of the WTO in 1995. The road to the WTO was a twisting one of diplomacy, political economy, and power politics, with the United States, above all, as the most important player.

Yet often lost in the description of the WTO as a tool of American power politics or a space for disempowered negotiation by developing countries is a sense of the animating ideas behind the enterprise itself. What we recover in the writings of the Hayekians at the GATT is a genealogy of thought that linked the neoliberal world economic imaginary from the 1920s to the 1990s. For my narrative it offers the last episode of the twentieth-century neoliberal search for an institutional fix in a world they saw as always threatened by spasms of democracy and the destructive belief that global rules could be remade to bend toward social justice. If the idea of “one world” had a moment at the end of the Second World War, it had a decade in the 1970s. Visions and models of the world economy exploded in expert circles and public culture. The “blue marble” photograph of the whole earth from outer space, first available in 1968, was a symbol of the first Earth Day in 1970 and eventually became one of the most reproduced images of all time.

In a 1965 Geneva speech, the U.S. ambassador to the United Nations, Adlai Stevenson, coined a metaphor that would echo through the following decade. He envisioned earth’s inhabitants as “passengers on a little space ship, dependent on its vulnerable reserves of air and soil; all committed for our safety to its security and peace; preserved from annihilation only by the care, the work, and I will say, the love we give our fragile craft.”
The earth was decentered by the “awful majesty of outer space,” drawing attention to the precarity of human existence and the need for global cooperation to ensure species survival.

zh: 1970年代，随着新技术的投入使用，这艘“脆弱飞船”的确切尺寸与承载能力被换算成数字与预测。正如一位联合国官员1976年所说：“全球模型无须另作论证，它们不过是计算机时代的自然且不可避免的产物。”
1970年代，计量经济学家纷纷支持七十七国集团提出的国际经济新秩序。全球改良主义者们为国际再分配方案赋予科学权威的努力，在1980年达到顶点——这一年发表了由前西德总理维利·勃兰特（Willy Brandt）领导的委员会撰写的“南北”报告，副标题是“一项生存纲领”。
他们主张，借助知识、计划——以及计算机，“地球号宇宙飞船”能够被改造成一艘更加符合社会正义要求的飞船。
en: In the 1970s the exact dimensions and capacities of the “fragile craft” were turned into numbers and forecasts by the application of new technologies. As one UN official put it in 1976, “global models need no justification except that they are a natural and inevitable product of the age of the computer.”

Econometricians threw their weight behind the demands of the G-77 nations for a NIEO in the 1970s. The efforts of global reformists to give scientific authority to projects of international redistribution culminated in the 1980 “North-South” report of the commission led by former West German chancellor Willy Brandt sub-titled “A Program for Survival.”
Through knowledge, plans—and computers—they argued, Spaceship Earth could be made a more socially just vessel.

zh: 行星意识的兴起，以及左翼经济学家与全球南方领导人携手合作的尝试，已经开始找到属于自己的历史学家。较少为人所知的，是本书这些篇章所讲述的故事：新自由主义对国际经济新秩序以及计算机辅助的全球改良主义努力的反抗。本章呈现了一个意味深长的事实——就在世界专家共同体的一部分人主张世界经济是可见的之际，一股新自由主义的反向运动却坚称它不可见、也超出一切再现之外。哈耶克在诺贝尔奖演说中谈到的“知识的僭妄”（pretense of knowledge），以及他对世界经济之不可知的坚持，为关贸总协定改革者在全球层面引入“法治”的努力提供了基底。如此行事，他们仰仗的是一种没有数字的世界经济图景。“地球号宇宙飞船”的全球经济——那个充斥着总量、数量与差距的领域——烟消云散，让位于一个哈耶克式的、由信号构成的世界经济。
en: The rise of planetary consciousness and the endeavor of left-wing economists to collaborate with Global South leaders has begun to find its historians. Less well-known is the story told in these pages of the neoliberal opposition to efforts at NIEO and computer-aided global reformism. This chapter has presented a telling fact: At the very moment when a faction of the world expert community argued that the world economy could be seen, a countermovement of neoliberals insisted that it was invisible and beyond representation. Hayek’s Nobel speech about the “pretense of knowledge” and his insistence on the unknowability of the world economy underpinned the efforts of GATT reformers to introduce the “rule of law” at the global level. In so doing, they relied on a vision of the world economy without numbers. The global economy of Spaceship Earth—a domain of volumes, quantities, and disparities—vanished to make way for a Hayekian world economy of signals.

zh: 新自由主义者对民族国家说“是”，只要存在一个更大的制度框架，拥有哈耶克所谓“说不的权力”。当各国对这种超国家安排说“不”时，它们就成了“经济民族主义者”，越出了可接受的界域。在新自由主义者看来，带有国际主义色彩的国际经济新秩序恰恰是对国际主义本身的攻击。按照日内瓦学派的观点，民族国家必须承认自身被安置于全球制度与法律安排之中这一前提——而这种安置主要就是由一套约束体系构成的。国际经济新秩序看起来是为挣脱新殖民主义束缚作出的进一步努力，完成彼得斯曼所描述的“经济非殖民化”。
它是一头从新自由主义噩梦中孵化出来的怪物：雅各宾主义扩散到全球，工会主义扩散到全球，平等主义扩散到全球，对私有财产的制度极尽轻蔑。条约必须遵守（pacta sunt servanda）、待遇的最低标准、跨国经济法的诫命，统统成了没有分量的规范，在1974年的那一声声宣言中被一扫而空。
en: Neoliberals said yes to the nation as long as there was a larger institutional framework that would have what Hayek called the “powers to say no.” When nations said no to such supranational arrangements, they became “economic nationalists” and moved beyond the pale. To neoliberals, the internationalist NIEO was an attack on internationalism itself. In the Geneva School view, the nation must recognize the precondition of its placement within global institutions and legal arrangements—and that placement consisted largely of a system of constraints. The NIEO looked like a further turn of the screw to break the bonds of neocolonialism and carry out what Petersmann described as “economic decolonization.”
It was a monster hatched from neoliberal nightmares: a Jacobinism gone global, a trade unionism gone global, an egalitarianism gone global, derisive of the institutions of private property.
the minimum standard of treatment, the commandments of transnational economic law, were norms without weight, swept aside in the 1974 pronouncements.

zh: 在更深的层面上，国际经济新秩序代表着哈耶克所谓“建构主义”（constructivism）的威胁。它没有足够重视本能行动的重要性，也没有足够重视那条控制论式的洞见——秩序需要一个中立而统一的规则框架，均衡才得以盛行。前文已述，哈耶克认为真正的危险不在于丛林法则，而在于工程师的法则。就此意义而言，国际经济新秩序不是部落主义的痉挛发作，而是理性主义情绪的周期性涌动——不是（用欧文·克里斯托〔Irving Kristol〕的那句名言说）“以‘茅茅’式的手段威逼西方”，而是拿圣西门式的规划对付西方。
它是一种狂妄，高估了人类凭一纸法令重新设计国际法的能力。必须捍卫这种使反射性行动得以发生的框架，使其免受各种理性设计运动的冲击。
en: At a deeper level the NIEO represented the threat of what Hayek called “constructivism.” It did not take seriously enough the importance of instinctive action and the cybernetic insight that order required a neutral and uniform framework of rules for equilibrium to prevail. As mentioned earlier, Hayek saw the real danger not in the rule of the jungle but in the rule of the engineers. The NIEO in this sense was not a spasm of tribalism but a periodic upsurge of rationalist sentiment—not “mau-mauing” the West, as Irving Kristol famously put it, but Saint-Simoning the West.

It was hubris and overestimation of the power of the human capacity to redesign international law by fiat. The framework for reflexive action had to be defended against the campaigns of rational action.

zh: 有学者指出：“1970年代，关于国际经济新秩序的种种动静，在日内瓦还只是幕后隐约可闻的声响。”

对日内瓦学派的新自由主义者来说，这些声音却绝非微弱。毋宁说，他们正是针对全球南方高亢的诉求来界定自己的反纲领的。帝国终结之后全球南方动员的危险在于，多数人的意志可能变成新的规范，哪怕违背根深蒂固之强权的意愿。国际经济新秩序展现出这样一种前景：欧洲海外帝国解体所开启的那个进程将得以延续，甚至臻于完成——人们害怕的，是国际法本身的非殖民化这一骇人听闻的前景。国际经济新秩序缺乏“秩序”，是一个需要矫正的问题，矫正之道在于击退联合国对国际法律实践的侵蚀，确立有约束力的仲裁与裁判制度——包括勒斯勒尔与彼得斯曼日后将为世贸组织参与设计的争端解决机制。针对七十七国集团把法律用于自身图谋的尝试，日内瓦学派奋力夺回法律，使之重新充当私有财产与竞争的强制执行者。1970年代的新自由主义纲领所关涉的，不是增长、均衡、最优化、平等、社会正义或繁荣。它关乎的是一个相互依赖的复杂系统的再生产——保卫世界经济的总体性，抵御来自民族主义者的攻击，在他们看来，这种攻击可能酿成堪与1930年代相比的大灾难。
en: One scholar argues that “in the 1970s noises off stage about a New International Economic Order could be faintly heard in Geneva.”

For Geneva School neoliberals, the sounds were far from faint. Indeed, they defined their counterprogram against the strident demands of the Global South. The danger of Global South mobilization after the end of empire was that the will of the majority could become a new norm, even against the desires of the entrenched powers. The NIEO presented the prospect of a continuation and perhaps a completion of the process that dissolution of European overseas empires had begun: the fear was of the scandalous prospect of a decolonization of international law. The lack of “order” in the NIEO was a problem to be corrected by beating back the encroachment of the UN on international legal practice and the establishment of binding arbitration and adjudication, including the dispute settlement mechanisms that Roessler and Petersmann would help design for the WTO. Against the attempt of the G-77 to use law for their own purposes, the Geneva School fought to reclaim law as an enforcer of private property and competition. The neoliberal program in the 1970s was not about growth, equilibrium, optimum, equality, social justice, or prosperity. It was about the reproduction of an interdependent complex system—the defense of the totality of the world economy against an assault from nationalists that threatened to be as much of a catastrophe as the 1930s.

zh: 到1970年代末，在主管世界贸易的首要国际机构——关贸总协定——内部，日内瓦学派已形成共识：价格体系的“扭曲”不是经济问题，而是政治问题。从1977年起，这些问题被视为最好经由宪法化进程来解决，其范本就是欧洲共同体的多层级结构。一位学者指出，哈耶克“频频用机器来说明他的心智理论”；而日内瓦学派的新自由主义者则反过来用哈耶克的心智理论来说明世界经济秩序。
哈耶克无力或不愿与数学和统计学真正交手，这使他未能走上受控制论与系统分析启发的经济学家们所行进的主干道。

在日内瓦学派的新自由主义中，我们发现哈耶克的影响不在经济学领域，而在法律领域。通过校准人类的制度，使价格信号的流动受到的阻滞降到最低，用新自由主义者自己的术语说，世界经济就能被改造成一部分层秩序的模型：全球系统与各国、各区域的子系统协同运转，容许信息顺畅传递，并确保商业交易的可预期性。1978年，图姆利尔参与合著的一份关贸总协定出版物表明了它对控制论的认同，它呼吁建立“一套使市场成为有效信号装置、并使经济得以由这些信号导引的法律与政策框架”。
日内瓦学派以“同法”（isonomy）的愿景——为世界经济立一部法律，不区分历史上较穷或较富的民众与国家——取代了国际经济新秩序所主张的国家自主及其再分配诉求。
en: By the end of the 1970s, there was a Geneva School consensus in the primary international institution devoted to governing trade, the GATT, that “distortions” of the price system were not economic problems but political problems. Beginning in 1977 these were seen as best solved through processes of constitutionalization modeled on the multitiered structure of the European Community. If Hayek “frequently uses machines to illustrate his theory of mind,” as one scholar observes, Geneva School neoliberals used Hayek’s theory of mind to illustrate world economic order.
Hayek’s inability or unwillingness to engage with mathematics and statistics kept him off the main road taken by economists inspired by cybernetics and systems analysis.

In Geneva School neoliberalism, we find Hayek’s influence not in the field of economics but in the field of law. By calibrating human institutions to offer minimal resistance to the movement of the price signal, the world economy could, to use neoliberals’ terms, be turned into a model of stratified order with global systems and national and regional subsystems operating in tandem to permit the smooth transmission of information and ensure predictability in commercial transactions. A GATT publication coauthored by Tumlir bore its cybernetic bona fides in 1978 when it called for the “framework of laws and policies which makes the market an effective signaling device and which allows the economy to be guided by those signals.”

In place of the national autonomy under an NIEO and its demands for redistribution, the Geneva School offered a vision of isonomy—one law for the world economy that did not distinguish between historically poorer and richer populations or countries.

zh: 1970至1980年代在日内瓦展开的讨论，重新接续了哈耶克与罗宾斯在1930年代开展的讨论。在这两个时刻，新自由主义的联邦愿景都认为：只要总体性维系得住，民族独立是可以接受的。在通商条约、契约神圣与财产这些方面，“国际主义”必须占据上风。只要自由的民族安稳地束缚在世界经济秩序的纽带之内，非殖民化就不成其为问题。事实上，享有形式主权的辖区日渐增多甚至可能是有益的，因为它使投资与创新的管辖区域倍增，从而促使各国竞相营造对资本有吸引力的环境。正如图姆利尔在为哈耶克祝寿所作的演讲中所说：“经济学家把由众多主权国家构成的世界，看作一个政治观念的竞争市场。”
他写道：“企业如此，主权国家亦然，它们不断从彼此的错误中学习。哈耶克认为，这正是人类进步的主要源泉——人类起初被分编成语言与仪式互不相通的诸群体。”
晚近批评者口中的“竞争型国家”（competition state），在新自由主义世界里被设想为哈耶克式网络中的一个通过模仿而学习的节点。
en: The discussions in Geneva in the 1970s and 1980s revived those of Hayek and Robbins in the 1930s. At both moments, the neoliberal vision of federation held that national independence was acceptable as long as the totality held. “Internationalism” had to prevail with respect to commercial treaties, sanctity of contract, and property. If free nations remained snug within the bonds of world economic order, then decolonization presented no problems. Indeed, the proliferation of formally sovereign territories could even be useful by multiplying the jurisdictions for investment and innovation, leading to pressure on states to create attractive climates for capital. As Tumlir said in his talk given for Hayek’s birthday: “The economist sees the world of many sovereign countries as a competitive market for political ideas.”

“Firms, and also sovereign nations, continue to learn from each other’s mistakes,” he noted. “This, Hayek suggests, has been the main source of progress of mankind originally structured into groups incomprehensible to each other by language and ritual.”
What latter-day critics have dubbed the “competition state” was conceived in the neoliberal world as a node of imitative learning in a Hayekian network.

zh: 新自由主义者欢迎流变，视之为市场那种更高明、却也晦暗不明的智慧统治世界的必要条件。秩序不是一种稳态，而是一种调适，一个往往伴随着痛苦的习得过程。这是一种结构性调适的学说，但更切题地说，它是一种“永不停息的”（
）调适的学说。对这一多层级体系的贸易规则进行微调必不可少，唯有如此，信号才能顺畅流动，从而为个体经济行动者顺应市场讯息而不断灵活调整自身行动塑造条件。
en: Neoliberals welcomed flux as the necessary condition of a world ruled by the superior, if opaque, wisdom of the market. Order was not a steady state but an adjustment, an often painful process of learning. This was a doctrine of structural adjustment, but more to the point it was one of

adjustment. Fine-tuning of the trade rules of the multilevel system was necessary to allow the signals to move smoothly, thus creating the conditions for the supple and eternal contortion of individual economic actors to the messages of the market.
